descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Servizi di frode (100%)

Zurigo | bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Riferimento 8286

Möchtest du die Sicherheit im Kartengeschäft aktiv mitgestalten und zwei Teams führen, die Betrugsfälle bearbeiten sowie Fraud-Risiken frühzeitig erkennen und wirksam begrenzen? Dann übernimm die Leitung unserer Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring) und Fraud Intelligence.

Als Head Fraud Services verintwortest du die fachliche und personelle Führung der Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring) und Fraud Intelligence. Du stellst einen zuverlässigen operativon Betrieb sicher, steuerst die Weiterentwicklung der Fraud Detection und Prevention und förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit internan sowie externen Partnern.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Fachliche und personelle Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung der Teams Fraud Services und Fraud Intelligence

• Sicherstellung des operativin Fraud Monitorings, der Bearbeitung von Betrugsverdachtsfällen und des Fraud Incident Managements

• Steuerung der Analyse neuer Fraud-Trends sowie der Definition, Priorisierung und Wirksamkeitsmessung geeigneter Gegenmassnahmen

• Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des Rule Managements, der Fraud Prevention Prozesse sowie der rilevantien Reports und KPIs

• Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Schemes, Behörden sowie internan und externen Partnern und Vertretung des Bereichs

• Gestione degli incidenti

Das brings du mit

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder höhere Weiterbildung mit ausgewiesor Berufserfahrung im Finanz-oder Kartengeschäft

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Fraud Management, vorzugsweise im Bereich Debitkarten und TWINT.

• Führungserfahrung sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams zielorientiert zu entwickeln und Veränderungen wirksam umzusetzen

• Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten verbunden mit einer strukturierten, qualitätsorientierten Arbeitsweise

• Klare und professionelle Kommunikation sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Julia Schmidt al numero +41583998670 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a dare forma al futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Specialista dei pagamenti (80 - 100%)

Zurigo | Possibilità di lavorare in casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8193

Desiderate sostenere il nostro team nelle SIC Operations e dare un contributo importante alla qualità della piazza finanziaria svizzera? Allora non vediamo l'ora di sentire la tua opinione. Anche i nostri partecipanti (banche in Svizzera e in tutta Europa) devono attuare tempestivamente numerose modifiche nel traffico dei pagamenti. In questo ruolo sei il centro di monitoraggio e contatto per le richieste di supporto relative alle transazioni di pagamento elettronico. Lavorerai su turni (dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 6:30 alle 19:30) compresi incarichi su chiamata (dopo 1 anno) fuori dall'orario di ufficio. Hai anche l'opportunità di lavorare su vari progetti. Per questa posizione varia ed entusiasmante, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido (SIX Office & Home Office).

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Supporto di 1° e 2° livello per il traffico dei pagamenti svizzero (SIC – compresi Instant Payments – ed euroSIC)

• Monitoraggio dei sistemi di pagamento (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) e collegamenti tecnici

• Amministrazione e mantenimento dei dati anagrafici dei partecipanti

• Coordinamento con la Banca nazionale svizzera e la Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Partecipazione ad esercitazioni specialistiche di emergenza e partecipazione a progetti

• Vari lavori amministrativi

Questo è quello che porti con te

• Formazione commerciale di base (tirocinio commerciale, scuola commerciale o formazione equivalente), l'esperienza nel traffico dei pagamenti costituisce un vantaggio

• Disponibilità a lavorare su turni (dal lunedì al venerdì: dalle 6:30 alle 19:30)

• Dopo ca. 1 anno: Disponibilità al servizio di reperibilità fuori orario d'ufficio compresi fine settimana/festivi

• Un alto livello di indipendenza e disponibilità ad aiutare

• Giocatore di squadra e ama il contatto con i clienti

• Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (Word, Excel, Visio ecc.)

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese parlata e scritta, costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza del francese

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina delle FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questo posto vacante consideriamo solo candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo con favore le candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What distinguishes us is driving us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of the financial markets with us.

Payment Specialist (80 - 100%)

Zurich, up to 40% Home Office possible, reference 8193

You want to support our team in SIC Operations and make an important contribution to the quality of the Swiss financial centre? Then we are happy to hear from you. Many changes in payment transactions must also be implemented by our participants (banks in Switzerland and throughout Europe). In this function you are the monitoring and start-up center for support requests regarding electronic payment transactions. You work in shift operations (Monday to Friday between 06.30am – 19.30pm) including piket operations (after 1 year) outside office hours.

You also have the opportunity to work in various projects. For this varied and exciting position we offer a hybrid work model (SIX Office & Home Office).

These are your tasks

• 1st and 2nd level support for Swiss payments (SIC – including instant payments – and euroSIC)

• Monitoring of payment systems (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) and technical connections

• Management and maintenance of the participant master data

• Coordination with the Swiss National Bank and the Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Participation in specialist emergency exercises and cooperation in projects

• Various administrative work

You bring this with you

• Commercial basic training (commercial apprenticeship, trade school or equivalent training), experience in payment of benefits

• ready to shift shift (Monday to Friday: between 06.30 – 19.30)

• After about 1 year: ready for piket service outside office hours including weekend/feetage

• A high degree of independence and helpfulness

• Team of the players and joy of customer contact

• Very good knowledge of MS Office (Words.2, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Very good German and English skills in word and writing, French skills is a plus

If you have any questions, please visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +3 91 333 51 49.

For this vacancy we take into account only direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we are happy about applications regardless of the personal background.

Payment Specialist (80 - 100%)

Zurich | bis zu 40% Home Office moeglich | Referenz 8193

Du möchtest unser Team im SIC Operations unterstützen und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität des Schweizer Finanzplatzes leisten? Dann freuen wir uns von dir zu hören. Viele Änderungen im Zahlungsverkehr müssen auch unsere Teilnehmer (Banken in der Schweiz und ganz Europa) rechtzeitig umsetzen. In dieser Funktion bist du die Überwachungs- und Anlaufzentrale für Support-Anfragen in Bezug zum elektronischen Zahlungsverkehr. Du arbeitest im Schichtbetrieb (Montag bis Freitag zwischen 06.30 – 19.30 Uhr) inkl. Pikett Einsätze (nach 1 Jahr) ausserhalb der Bürozeiten. Weiterhin hast du die Möglichkeit, in diversen Projekten mitzuarbeiten. Für diese abwechslungsreiche und spannende Position bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell (SIX Office & Home Office) an.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• 1st und 2nd Level Support für den Schweizerischen Zahlungsverkehr (SIC – inkl. Instant Payments – und euroSIC)

• Überwachung der Zahlungssysteme (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) und der technischen Verbindungen

• Verwaltung und Pflege der Teilnehmerstammdaten

• Koordination mit der Schweizerischen Nationalbank sowie der Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Teilnahme an fachspezifischen Notfallübungen sowie Mitarbeit in Projekten

• Verschiedene administrative Arbeiten

Das bringst du mit

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung (Kaufmännische Berufslehre, Handelsschule oder gleichwertige Ausbildung), Erfahrung im Zahlungsverkehr von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (Montag bis Freitag: Zwischen 06.30 – 19.30 Uhr)

• Nach ca. 1 Jahr: Bereitschaft für Pikettdienst ausserhalb der Bürozeiten inkl. Wochenende/Feiertage

• Ein hohes Mass an Selbstständigkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft

• Teamplayer und Freude am Kundenkontakt

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Französischkenntnisse ist ein Plus

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

SIX est le moteur de la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

Spécialiste des paiements (80 - 100%)

Zurich | Jusqu'à 40 % de bureau à domicile possible | Référence 8193

Vous souhaitez soutenir notre équipe dans SIC Operations et apporter une contribution importante à la qualité de la place financière suisse ? Alors nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. Nos participants (banques en Suisse et dans toute l'Europe) doivent également mettre en œuvre en temps opportun de nombreux changements dans le trafic des paiements. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes le centre de veille et de contact pour les demandes de support liées aux transactions de paiement électronique. Vous travaillez en équipes (du lundi au vendredi entre 6h30 et 19h30) y compris des missions d'astreinte (après 1 an) en dehors des heures de bureau. Vous avez également la possibilité de travailler sur divers projets. Pour ce poste varié et passionnant, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride (SIX Office & Home Office).

Ce sont vos tâches

• Support de 1er et 2ème niveaux pour le trafic des paiements suisse (SIC – y compris Instant Payments – et euroSIC)

• Surveillance des systèmes de paiement (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) et des connexions techniques

• Administration et maintenance des données de base des participants

• Coordination avec la Banque nationale suisse et la Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Participation à des exercices d'urgence spécialisés et participation à des projets

• Divers travaux administratifs

C'est ce que tu apportes avec toi

• Formation commerciale de base (apprentissage commercial, école de commerce ou formation équivalente), une expérience dans le domaine des opérations de paiement est un atout

• Volonté de travailler par quarts (du lundi au vendredi : entre 6h30 et 19h30)

• Après env. 1 an : Volonté d'effectuer des gardes en dehors des heures de bureau, y compris les week-ends/jours fériés

• Un haut niveau d'indépendance et de volonté d'aider

• Esprit d'équipe et apprécie le contact client

• Très bonne connaissance de MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais parlés et écrits, la connaissance du français est un plus

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, c'est pourquoi nous acceptons les candidatures quel que soit votre parcours personnel.

• Neue sowie bestehende Kunden vor Ort oder Online schulen

• Erstellung und Pflege der Benutzeranleitungen und Webinare

• Erfahrung im Bereich Notariats-, Grundbuch-, oder Hypothekarwesen

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse – Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt at +41 583 994 236 .

• Experience with testing, acceptance, go-live preparation, incident handling, second-level support, service management and operational handover.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to banks, customers, business teams, IT partners and vendors.

SIX est à l'origine de la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous conduit à l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits intelligents et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

Élèves actifs 40-60

Olten, 40-60%, référence 8384

Vous voulez acquérir de véritables connaissances sur un environnement financier international et le façonner activement au lieu de simplement courir avec vos études? Alors vous avez exactement raison avec nous!

Assetenciing est un département très diversifié avec des équipes spécialisées en Suisse et en Espagne. Ensemble, nous nous assurons que nos services dans les domaines des actions d'entreprise, de l'Alaska Processing et de Proxy Ling sont fournis de manière fiable et efficace. En tant qu'étudiant en activité, vous travaillez directement dans les activités opérationnelles quotidiennes – et vous avez également la possibilité d'analyser les processus, d'identifier le potentiel d'optimisation et de présenter vos propres idées.

En tant qu'entreprise moderne, dynamique et innovante, nous offrons une variété d'opportunités pour développer votre potentiel dans le monde passionnant de la technologie et de la finance. Nous vous soutenons dans votre entrée dans la carrière, investissons dans votre développement et développez vos compétences personnelles. En tant qu'"Etudiante en Travail" jusqu'à ce que vous soyez membre de notre communauté de Jeunes Talents et faites partie d'un réseau de débutants de carrière dédiés.

Tâches
- Travail dans les affaires quotidiennes dans divers domaines de l'entretien des actifs (91 Actions, Hawaii, Vote de procuration)
- Soutien au traitement rapide et de qualité des commandes des clients
- Analyse des processus et coopération dans le développement de Proezssen
- Apporter des suggestions d'amélioration et d'appui dans leur mise en œuvre
- Coopération avec plusieurs équipes et interfaces internationales

Besoins
- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en cours (p. ex. économie, finances, banques, données/analyses ou comparables)
- Un apprentissage bancaire achevé, l'expérience dans le domaine des services de valeurs mobilières sont bénéfiques
- Pensée analytique et joie dans l'interrogation et l'amélioration des choses
- Orientation client et service supérieure à la moyenne
- Méthodes de travail indépendantes, structurées et fiables
- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

Nous offrons
- Une partie de la communauté des jeunes talents
- Une partie d'un réseau de débutants de carrière dédiés
- Appui à l'entrée dans la carrière
- Investir dans votre développement et développer vos compétences personnelles

Personne à contacter
Pour toute question, veuillez consulter notre page FAQ ou contacter Maria Teresa Buchanan au +41 58 399 8083.

Pour cette vacance, nous ne prenons en compte que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, donc nous sommes heureux des applications indépendamment de l'expérience personnelle.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge in avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondamenta e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Ingegnere di Test Senior (80-100%)

Zurigo | Fino al 40% di home office possibile | Riferimento 8324

Ti piace lavorare in un team dinamico e in un ambiente agile

e l'automazione dei test è il tuo punto di forza? Allora diventa Senior Test Engineer presso Terravis e partecipa attivamente allo sviluppo di soluzioni intelligenti e scalabili.

In qualità di piattaforma digitale leader, Terravis definisce gli standard nella gestione digitale interdominio delle transazioni immobiliari e collega l'industria finanziaria, il notariato e il registro fondiario per processi immobiliari e transazioni immobiliari sicuri, efficienti e conformi alla legge. Come parte del nostro team di Business Engineering & Testing, lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder interni ed esterni per sviluppare ulteriormente e ottimizzare l'offerta di Terravis. Saremo lieti di ricevere i tuoi documenti di candidatura.

Doveri

- Lavori a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo e DevOps e condividi il tuo know-how di testing con il team.
- Esecuzione di test manuali in base alle esigenze interne/ del cliente, documentazione e analisi dei risultati dei test.
- Creazione di ticket Jira significativi come base per la correzione dei bug durante lo sviluppo e allo stesso tempo come supporto decisionale per la gestione delle release.
- Esecuzione e documentazione di test automatizzati.
- Supporto nel refactoring delle macchine di test esistenti e nello sviluppo di una soluzione di automazione dei test scalabile.

Requisiti

- Architettura di test – Conosci la costruzione di framework di automazione dei test manutenibili e configurabili nella pratica.
- Acquisisci e gestisci autonomamente i dati di prova tramite interfacce come SQL Server o Excel e crei così le basi per test manuali e automatizzati riproducibili.
- Analisi degli errori e reporting – Capacità di identificare le cause degli errori durante l'esecuzione del test (incl. log, screenshot, report).
- Creazione di ticket significativi per i bug che si trovano nel soggetto del test con i test funzionali.
- Gestione sicura delle automazioni di prova – Gestione sicura del selenio Webdriver e del cucumber.
- Scriverai scenari di test gestibili e implementerai le relative definizioni step su tutti i browser (Chrome, Edge) contro la nostra applicazione web.
- Presupponiamo una solida esperienza in Java e Maven.
- La conoscenza di JavaScript è un vantaggio.
- Framework e strumenti – Esperienza con IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, JDBC, Jakarta (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab e Jira di Jetbrain.
- Lingue - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese scritto e parlato.

Contatto

Per qualsiasi domanda, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questo posto vacante prendiamo in considerazione solo le candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi siamo lieti di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal nostro background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What distinguishes us is driving us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of the financial markets with us.

Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich, Up to 40% HomeOffice possible, Reference 8324

You like working in a dynamic team and a agile environment

and test automation is your strength? Then become Senior Test Engineer at Terravis and actively shape how we develop smart, scalable solutions.

As a leading digital platform, Terravis sets standards in the domain-wide digital processing of property business and connects the financial industry, notarial and land accounting for secure, efficient and legally compliant property processes and property transactions. As part of our Business Engineering & Testing team, you work closely with internal and external stakeholders to further develop and optimize the range of services around Terravis. We look forward to receiving your application documents.

Tasks

- You work closely with development and DevOps and share your know-how with the team of the company. - Conduct manual tests based on internal requirements / customer requirements, documentation and analysis of test results. - Create meaningful Jira tickets as a basis for bugfixing during development and at the same time as a decision-making aid for release management. - Execution and documentation of automated tests. - Support for re-factoring of existing test machines and the development of a scalable test automation solution.

Requirements

- Test architecture – You know how to build up a ready-to-use and configurable test automation frameworks. - Test data is provided and used independently via interfaces such as SQL servers or Excel, thus creating the basis for reproducible manual and automated testing. - Error analysis and reporting – Ability to identify and fix errors in the test run (including logs, screenshots, reports). - Create meaningful tickets for bugs, which are found with the functional tests in the test subject.

- Safe handling of test automations – Safe handling of selenium webdriver and cucbridge. - You write time-tested test scenarios and implement the corresponding step definitions across browsers (Chrome, Edge) against our web application. - We require well-founded experience in Java and Maven. - JavaScript skills are beneficial. - Frameworks and tools – experience with jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucbridge, JDBC, java (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab and JIRA. - Languages - Very good German and English knowledge in word and writing.

Contact

If you have any questions, please visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +3 91 333 51 49.

For this vacancy we take into account only direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we are happy about applications regardless of the personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich | Bis zu 40 % Homeoffice möglich | Referenz 8324

Du arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Team und agilen Umfeld

und Testautomatisierung ist deine Stärke? Dann werde Senior Test Engineer bei Terravis und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir intelligente, skalierbare Lösungen entwickeln.

Als führende digitale Plattform setzt Terravis Massstäbe in der domänenübergreifenden digitalen Abwicklung von Grundstückgeschäften und vernetzt Finanzindustrie, Notariats- und Grundbuchwesen für sichere, effiziente und rechtskonforme Immobilienprozesse und Grundstücktranskationen. Als Teil unseres Teams Business Engineering & Testing arbeitest du eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, um das Angebot rund um Terravis weiterzuentwickeln und zu optimieren. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen.

Aufgaben

- Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und DevOps zusammen und gibst dein Testing-Know-how im Team weiter.
- Durchführung von manuellen Tests auf Basis der Internen-Anforderungen / Kundenanforderungen, Dokumentation und Analyse der Testergebnisse.
- Erstellung von aussagekräftigen Jira-Tickets als Grundlage für das Bugfixing bei der Entwicklung und gleichzeitig als Entscheidungshilfe für das Releasemanagement.
- Ausführung und Dokumentation automatisierter Tests.
- Unterstützung beim Refactoring der bestehenden Testautomaten und der Entwicklung einer skalierbaren Testautomatisierungslösung.

Anforderungen

- Testarchitektur – Du kennst den Aufbau wartbarer und konfigurierbarer Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks aus der Praxis.
- Testdaten beschaffst und pflegst du eigenständig über Schnittstellen wie SQL-Server oder Excel und schaffst damit die Grundlage für reproduzierbares manuelles wie automatisiertes Testen.
- Fehleranalyse und Reporting – Fähigkeit, Fehlerursachen im Testlauf (inkl. Logs, Screenshots, Reports) zu identifizieren und zu beheben.
- Erstellen von aussagekräftigen Tickets für Bugs, welche mit den funktionalen Tests im Testsubjekt gefunden werden.
- Sicherer Umgang mit Testautomationen – Sicherer Umgang mit Selenium-Webdriver und Cucumber.
- Du schreibst wartbare Test-Szenarien und implementierst die dazugehörigen Step-Definitionen browserübergreifend (Chrome, Edge) gegen unsere Webapplikation.
- Fundierte Erfahrung in Java und Maven setzen wir voraus.
- JavaScript-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
- Frameworks und Tools – Erfahrung mit Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, JDBC, Jakarta (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab und JIRA.
- Sprachen - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Kontakt

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Capo dell'Adozione e della Capacità dell'AI (100%)

Zurigo | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 8391

SIX sta creando un AI Enablement Center a livello di gruppo per accelerare l'adozione di intelligenza artificiale e tradurre opportunità AI in risultati aziendali, clienti e di mercato misurabili.

Il Responsabile dell'Adozione AI & Capability è responsabile per aiutare i dipendenti e i team di SIX a comprendere, adottare e utilizzare efficacemente gli strumenti, i prodotti e le capacità AI.

Cosa farai

• Stabilire e gestire il supporto e la funzione di abilitazione AI centrale per i dipendenti attraverso SIX. Sostenere l'implementazione e l'adozione di strumenti e prodotti AI, garantendo ai dipendenti una comunicazione appropriata, una guida e una formazione.

• Stabilire ore di ufficio, sessioni di condivisione delle conoscenze AI e altri canali di supporto per rispondere alle domande dei dipendenti e fornire assistenza pratica.

• Mantenere un centro di conoscenza AI interno con documentazione, guide utente, FAQ, esempi e materiali di apprendimento riutilizzabili.

• Misurare l'adozione, l'efficacia della formazione, la soddisfazione dei dipendenti e l'utilità dei servizi di supporto.

• Lavorare con AI Portfolio & Governance per garantire la formazione e la guida riflettono i requisiti AI responsabili e le politiche rilevanti.

• Partner con HR Learning & Talent per coordinare i programmi di apprendimento AI e sfruttare i canali di apprendimento esistenti.

• Questo è un ruolo di base pratico. Inizialmente stabilire e utilizzare la funzione di abilitazione e funzionalità AI direttamente e gradualmente costruire il team come la domanda cresce.

Che cosa porta

• 5+ anni di esperienza come consulente tecnico, architetto di soluzioni, promotore di sviluppatori, ingegnere avanzato, allenatore tecnico o in un ruolo simile combinando ingegneria con abilitazione utente.

• Forte capacità di ingegneria AI con esperienza nell'istruzione tecnica, supporto interno o un campo correlato.

• In grado di imparare rapidamente nuovi strumenti AI, dimostrare le loro capacità e spiegarli al pubblico con diversi background tecnici.

• Esperienza di sviluppo e fornitura di formazione pratica, workshop, onboarding e documentazione dell'utente.

• Sperimenta di sviluppare basi di conoscenza, comunità di pratica o programmi peer-learning.

• In grado di raccogliere feedback degli utenti, identificare problemi ricorrenti e coordinare i miglioramenti con team tecnici e di prodotto.

• L'esperienza di lavoro in una grande o complessa organizzazione; i servizi finanziari o l'esperienza regolamentata-industria è un vantaggio.

• Prova a assumere e costruire squadre, con la capacità di stabilire una nuova funzione da zero.

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head of AI Adoption and Capability (100%)

Zurich | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8391

SIX is establishing a group-wide AI Enablement Center to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence and translate AI opportunities into measurable business, customer and market outcomes.

The Head of AI Adoption & Capability is responsible for helping employees and teams across SIX understand, adopt and effectively use AI tools, products and capabilities.

What You Will Do

• Establish and operate the central AI support and enablement function for employees across SIX. Support the rollout and adoption of AI tools and products, ensuring employees receive appropriate communication, guidance and training.

• Establish office hours, AI knowledge-sharing sessions and other support channels to answer employee questions and provide practical assistance.

• Maintain an internal AI knowledge hub with documentation, user guides, FAQs, examples and reusable learning materials.

• Measure adoption, training effectiveness, employee satisfaction and the usefulness of support services.

• Work with AI Portfolio & Governance to ensure training and guidance reflect responsible AI requirements and relevant policies.

• Partner with HR Learning & Talent to coordinate AI learning programs and leverage existing learning channels.

• This is a hands-on founding role. Initially establish and operate the AI enablement and capability function directly and gradually build the team as demand grows.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience as a technical consultant, solutions architect, developer advocate, forward-deployed engineer, technical trainer or in a similar role combining engineering with user enablement.

• Strong AI engineering skills with experience in technical education, internal support or a related field.

• Able to learn new AI tools quickly, demonstrate their capabilities and explain them to audiences with different technical backgrounds.

• Experience developing and delivering practical training, workshops, onboarding and user documentation.

• Experience developing knowledge bases, communities of practice or peer-learning programs.

• Able to gather user feedback, identify recurring problems and coordinate improvements with technical and product teams.

• Experience working in a large or complex organisation; financial services or regulated-industry experience is an advantage.

• Experience hiring and building teams, with the ability to establish a new function from the ground up.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX gestisce l'infrastruttura dietro i mercati finanziari svizzeri e spagnoli: scambi, post-commercializzazione, informazioni finanziarie e servizi bancari. Stiamo ricostruendo come SIX gestisce il suo portafoglio di progetti. Questo include un nuovo quadro per l'assegnazione di capitale di investimento, formati decisioni più taglienti per il Consiglio Esecutivo, e nuovi modi per finanziare iniziative in rapida evoluzione come l'AI. Questo è un periodo di riprogettazione attiva, non manutenzione. Ti unirai a una piccola squadra senior nel bel mezzo. Questo tirocinio è limitato a 6 mesi.

Cosa farai

• Eseguire il progetto mensile che controlla vicino. Come manager di chiusura, si coordina effettivi, previsioni e varianze in tutto il portafoglio, e si sfida i numeri prima che raggiungano la gestione.

• Forma la metodologia. Aiuta a progettare e testare nuovi modelli, criteri decisionali e formati di governance, e li vedi utilizzati nelle decisioni di investimento reali.
Trova modi più intelligenti per lavorare. Si utilizza l'analisi dei dati, l'analisi di Excel e la modellazione, e gli strumenti AI per automatizzare la segnalazione e l'intuizione della superficie più velocemente. Buone idee vengono implementate.

• Assumere un progetto analitico definito del proprio, per esempio benchmarking come altri FMI e banche allocano il capitale, o analizzando ciò che ha guidato i costi e il calendario sovraccarichi nel nostro portafoglio. SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Internship Project Portfolio Management and Project Controlling 80-100%

Zurich | 80-100% | Reference 8378

SIX runs the infrastructure behind the Swiss and Spanish financial markets: exchanges, post-trade, financial information and banking services. Every year, SIX invests a substantial budget in projects that shape that infrastructure. Our team makes sure that money goes to the right places, delivers what was promised, and gives the Executive Board a clear view of the whole portfolio.

We are rebuilding how SIX manages its project portfolio. This includes a new framework for allocating investment capital, sharper decision formats for the Executive Board, and new ways to fund fast-moving initiatives such as AI. This is a period of active redesign, not maintenance. You will join a small, senior team in the middle of it. This internship is limited to 6 months.

What you will do

• Run the monthly project controlling close. As closing manager, you coordinate actuals, forecasts and variances across the portfolio, and you challenge the numbers before they reach management.

• Build the portfolio view for senior management. You prepare reporting, dashboards and briefing material for the Executive Board and its committees. That means turning data from dozens of projects into a few messages a decision-maker can act on.

• Work alongside the Portfolio Manager and project controllers on project reviews: Is the business case still valid? Are budget, scope and timeline realistic? What should leadership know that the status report doesn’t say?

• Shape the methodology. You help design and test new templates, decision criteria and governance formats, and you see them used in real investment decisions.
Find smarter ways to work. You use data analysis, Excel and modeling, and AI tools to automate reporting and surface insight faster. Good ideas get implemented.

• Take on a defined analytical project of your own, for example benchmarking how other FMIs and banks allocate capital, or analyzing what has driven cost and schedule overruns in our portfolio. You present your findings to the team leadership at the end of your internship.

What you bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering or a related field, with a strong academic record

• A genuine interest in corporate finance, strategy and how large organizations make investment decisions

• Strong analytical skills: you are comfortable in Excel, can build a clean model, and know that a number without a story is useless

• Clear writing and visual thinking: you can compress a complex situation into one slide

• Rigor and reliability: You will be handling numbers that management relies on, and you notice when something doesn’t add up.

• Initiative: you suggest improvements rather than waiting to be asked

• Fluent in German and English

• Prior experience in consulting, audit, banking or corporate finance is a plus, not a requirement

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Do you want to help shape the future direction of SIX’s IT organization? Are you passionate about IT strategy, operating models and turning complex topics into actionable recommendations? Then the CIO Office wants to hear from you.

As part of a lean and high-performing team, you will work alongside the CIO Office Head and the Senior IT Strategy Manager to shape SIX’s IT Strategy, evolve the IT Operating Model and develop recommendations for senior leadership in an AI-enabled world.

You will work on the substance behind strategic decisions, including hypothesis development, strategic analysis, content creation, executive story-lining and recommendation development.

This role is ideal for a hands-on strategy professional who enjoys solving complex problems, building fact-based recommendations and turning ideas into results. As an individual contributor in a small, high-impact team, you will shape some of the most important strategic topics in SIX IT, partnering closely with senior leadership.

What You Will Do

• Co-create SIX’s IT Strategy and strategic roadmap , ensuring alignment with business priorities

• Help shape the evolution of the IT Operating Model and future organizational design

• Develop recommendations on how IT can better support business priorities and strategic objectives

• Structure complex challenges and develop fact-based hypotheses, recommendations, and strategic assessments

• Conduct analyses and benchmarking to support strategic decision-making

• Prepare executive-ready presentations and decision materials and compelling narratives for complex technology topics

• Support strategic discussions with senior management and governance bodies and partner with leaders across IT and business functions

• Drive strategic topics from analysis through recommendation and contribute hands-on to workshops, assessments, and strategic initiatives

• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, IT strategy, corporate strategy, operating model design or a comparable strategic role

• Proven experience in strategy development and/or operating model design

• Strong strategic and analytical problem-solving skills , with the ability to turn ambiguity into actionable recommendations

• Excellent communication, presentation and story-lining skills , including the ability to create executive-ready materials

• A hands-on, structured and pragmatic approach, with a strong can-do attitude and the ability to independently drive topics to outcomes

• A self-driven and collaborative mindset , with a passion for developing analyses, concepts, presentations and recommendations hands-on

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering or a related field, with a strong academic record

Informazioni sul ruolo

Per il nostro team IT Workplace, cerchiamo una persona operativa per il supporto onsite di livello 2, che garantisca servizi IT stabili, affidabili e incentrati sull'utente presso la nostra sede di Zurigo. Si prega di notare che il ruolo è interamente in ufficio al 100%.

Agirai come punto di contatto fondamentale per i nostri dipendenti in sede, gestirai casi di supporto complessi e contribuirai al miglioramento continuo e alla standardizzazione del nostro ambiente di lavoro, in stretta collaborazione con i team IT centrali e i partner esterni.

Cosa farai

- fornire supporto onsite di 2° livello (e supporto di riserva per il 1° livello quando richiesto) per i client Windows 11 e i servizi standard del workplace
- gestire incidenti e richieste di servizio tramite ITSM, incluse le attività IMACD e il coordinamento delle escalation

- gestire e supportare stampanti, sale riunioni e tecnologie di collaborazione (Teams Rooms, videoconferenze)
- supportare la gestione degli endpoint (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) per la registrazione dei dispositivi, i controlli di conformità e l'assegnazione del software

- garantire una documentazione accurata di soluzioni, processi e guide operative
- collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di engineering di 3° livello, i fornitori di servizi e gli stakeholder interni
- supportare progetti IT più piccoli relativi al workplace e iniziative di miglioramento continuo
- fungere da referente affidabile in sede per le iniziative e gli standard centrali

Cosa porti con te

- 2–4+ anni di esperienza nel supporto IT in sede o nell'IT service desk (livello 1/2) in ambienti aziendali
- solide competenze pratiche in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)
- esperienza pratica nel supporto hardware e nei rollout strutturati
- solida conoscenza di Active Directory / Azure AD e delle attività di base in Intune
- conoscenze di base del networking (fondamenti di TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN) per la risoluzione dei problemi in loco
- esperienza nella gestione dei processi di ticketing e degli asset, mentalità orientata agli SLA
- spiccato orientamento al servizio, affidabilità, metodo di lavoro strutturato e comunicazione chiara
- Tedesco fluente (parlato e scritto); buon inglese per la documentazione e le interazioni di supporto
- Certificazione ITIL Foundation o equivalente
- esperienza in grandi ambienti aziendali
- know-how su Microsoft Teams Rooms e sulla tecnologia per sale riunioni

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site. Please note that the role is 100% ofiice-based.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Contanti specialistici correlati C/A (80-100%)

Olten | 40% Home Office possibile | Riferimento 8223

Nel team Income Worldwide, elaborerai pagamenti internazionali di reddito e altre misure di capitale a base di denaro o di azioni da informazioni a liquidazione. Questo include dividendi, interessi, rimborsi ed esercizi di garanzia. Più di 50 mercati internazionali e una vasta gamma di prodotti, dalle equità e dai fondi alle obbligazioni e ai prodotti strutturati, forniscono un ambiente versatile nel business globale dei titoli.

Si assume la responsabilità di elaborare tempestivamente, analizzare le differenze di posizione e account e chiarire casi difficili con partner interni ed esterni. Inoltre, si porta le vostre idee in miglioramenti di processo e progetti. Lavori in un team esperto che condivide conoscenza e si sostiene a vicenda.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Elaborazione autonoma e tempestiva dei pagamenti di reddito e delle misure di capitale, dall'aviazione al regolamento

• Monitoraggio e riconciliazione delle posizioni e dei conti dei titoli e regolamento delle differenze e dei casi complessi

• Elaborazione di richieste di clienti e coordinamento con uffici specializzati, principali agenzie di pagamento e uffici di custodia

• Compliance con processi e standard di rischio e qualità e partecipazione attiva ai miglioramenti

• Collaborazione in progetti, documentazione e materiali di formazione, nonché servizi di piketting nell'ufficio di casa di sera e festivi

Lo porti con te.

• Istruzione commerciale o una qualificazione comparabile, idealmente nell'ambiente finanziario

• L'esperienza nel trattamento dei titoli, nel reddito o nelle azioni aziendali è un vantaggio

• Metodo di lavoro analitico, strutturato e preciso con elevata responsabilità, rischio e consapevolezza della qualità

• Personalità orientata al team e al cliente con iniziativa e comunicazione chiara

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Julia Schmidt al numero +41 583 994 236.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us forward: Between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Specialist Cash Related C/A (80-100%)

Olten | 40% Home Office possible | Reference 8223

In the Income Worldwide team, you will process international income payments and other cash- or stock-based capital measures from information to settlement. This includes dividends, interest, repayments and warrant exercises. More than 50 international markets and a wide range of products from equities and funds to bonds and structured products provide a versatile environment in the global securities business.

You take responsibility for timely processing, analyze position and account differences and clarify challenging cases with internal and external partners. In addition, you bring your ideas into process improvements and projects. You work in an experienced team that shares knowledge and supports each other.

• Agir en tant qu'associé stratégique de l'unité responsable de l'information financière sur les décisions qui façonnent l'entreprise

• Transformer le marché en un point de vue clair – dynamique de la concurrence et des fournisseurs, besoins des clients et nombres – et en recommandations

• Bâtir et présenter le matériel qui motive les décisions pour la haute direction

• Stratégie ou finance: conseil en gestion, stratégie d'entreprise, financement d'entreprise / banque d'investissement, idéalement exposé aux marchés financiers ou aux services d'information; ou

• Industrie : le secteur des données financières et de l'information – fournisseur de données ou fournisseur d'infrastructures de marché (p. ex. Bloomberg, LSEG, S&P Global, Morningstar, FactSet) – dans les rôles stratégiques, de produits ou commerciaux

• Une véritable sensation pour le paysage financier-information et data-vendor – les produits, les concurrents, et où se dirige le marché – ou la curiosité et la rapidité pour y arriver rapidement

• Capacité éprouvée de diriger des initiatives stratégiques en bout de ligne, y compris l'élaboration de la justification stratégique et de l'orientation des fusions-acquisitions et des investissements majeurs

• Pensée analytique et conceptuelle pointue – vous pouvez encadrer un problème ambigu et construire le bien-fondé d'une décision

• Tout aussi à l'aise avec les chiffres et le narratif – vous pouvez construire ou tester une analyse de rentabilisation et l'atterrir dans une présentation prête au conseil d'administration

• Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en affaires, en économie, en finance, en génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe; un diplôme avancé est un plus

• L'anglais fluent est essentiel. Allemand et/ou espagnol est un plus

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8096

Do you want to define and govern how cryptographic keys are secured across a financial enterprise? Are you motivated by combining security, risk, and regulatory requirements into real control frameworks?

Join SIX as a Key Management Security Officer and take ownership of key management governance, ensuring secure and auditable cryptographic controls across critical platforms.

What You Will Do

• Define and enforce key management policies, standards, and controls

• Oversee the full lifecycle of cryptographic keys (generation to destruction)

• Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, FINMA, DORA)

• Support audits and maintain evidence for control traceability

• Assess risks and define mitigation measures for key management environments

What You Bring

• Strong knowledge of cryptography and key lifecycle management

• Experience with HSMs and key management platforms (e.g., Keyfactor, cloud KMS,Securesys,Thales,Entrust)

• Proven background in audit, compliance, or regulated environments

• Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills

• Degree in information security or related field; certifications (CISSP, CISM) are a plus

Étudiant·e en emploi dans le support client 60-70%

Zurich | 60-70% | Référence 8266

Tu souhaites acquérir une première expérience professionnelle parallèlement à tes études et contribuer de manière importante à la qualité de la place financière suisse ? Tu es une personne organisée, à l’aise avec la technologie et dotée de solides compétences conceptuelles ? Alors nous serons ravis d’avoir de tes nouvelles ! Tu seras chargé·e de réviser et de mettre à jour notre base de connaissances, d’établir des statistiques et des analyses mensuelles et de soutenir l’équipe dans l’optimisation des processus de travail.

Nous offrons

- En tant qu’entreprise moderne, dynamique et innovante, nous offrons de nombreuses possibilités de développer ton potentiel dans le monde passionnant de la technologie et de la finance.
- Nous t’accompagnons dans tes débuts professionnels, investissons dans ton développement et dans l’élargissement de tes compétences personnelles.
- En tant que « Working Student », tu fais partie de notre communauté NextGen et tu fais partie d’un réseau de Career Starter engagés.

Voici tes tâches

- Révision, maintenance et mise à jour continue de la base de connaissances du support dans Confluence et SharePoint.
- Participation à des réunions récurrentes et suivi correspondant (EPICs du support, organisation et documentation des processus).
- Soutien de l’équipe dans divers domaines, avec un accent sur l’optimisation des processus de travail.
- Soutien dans l’analyse des processus métier
- Création et mise à jour de la documentation des processus, des instructions de travail et des directives

Ce que tu apportes

- Études en cours (bachelor ou master) dans le domaine de l’économie ou de l’informatique
- Affinité avec la technologie ainsi qu’un intérêt pour les moyens de paiement numériques
- Très bonnes capacités analytiques et conceptuelles, sens du service, pensée en réseau, ainsi que flexibilité et méthode de travail rigoureuse

- Très bonnes connaissances de l’allemand et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit

Pour toute question, consultez notre page FAQ ou contactez Janine Reichling au numéro +41 58 399 42 99.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous ne prendrons en considération que les candidatures directes.

La diversité nous tient à cœur, c’est pourquoi nous nous réjouissons des candidatures, quel que soit le parcours personnel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8241

Do you want to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering and solving complex technical challenges in a distributed environment?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in Zurich and India. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with end-to-end technical ownership, shaping robust solutions from design through production. You will collaborate closely with product managers, domain experts, SRE teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and effective systems.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Take technical ownership of complex components and features, from solution design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Deep hands-on software engineering expertise with Java (Spring Boot) and Python, including building, testing, deploying, and supporting production services

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and make sound architecture and engineering decisions in production environments

• Strong knowledge of backend and distributed system design, including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, and maintainable integration patterns

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Strategia di testa e sviluppo commerciale Servizi

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8043

Il capo dello sviluppo commerciale e della strategia forma e fornisce l'agenda di crescita di SIX Securities Services. Il ruolo guida iniziative strategiche trasversali, nuove creazione di business, partnership e opportunità M&A, assicurando che BSS sia posizionata come fornitore leader europeo di infrastrutture post-trade.

Operando in tutte le verticali del prodotto, traduce la strategia in esecuzione, sblocca nuove opportunità di ricavi e supporta la leadership senior nello sviluppo a lungo termine dell'unità aziendale.

Cosa farai

• Guidare l'esecuzione strategica: Traduci la strategia BSS in chiare roadmap, assicurando la consegna disciplinata, la gestione del rischio e risultati misurabili.

• Identificare e fornire opportunità di crescita: Espandi flussi di ricavi attraverso la compensazione, la custodia, la finanza dei titoli e servizi a valore aggiunto, compresi nuovi mercati e segmenti dei clienti.

• Partenariati leader e iniziative M&A: sviluppare partnership strategiche e gestire opportunità di crescita inorganiche dalla valutazione all'integrazione.

• Consiglia la leadership senior: fornire informazioni strategiche, casi aziendali e monitoraggio delle prestazioni per supportare il processo decisionale a livello esecutivo.

• Assicurare l’allineamento interfunzionale: promuovere la collaborazione tra le unità aziendali e rafforzare il posizionamento di SIX con i clienti e all’interno dell’ecosistema dei mercati dei capitali.

Che cosa porta

• Ampia strategia e esperienza di leadership: comprovato track record nella strategia aziendale, consulenza o sviluppo aziendale all'interno di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario o mercati di capitale.

• Forte messa a fuoco di esecuzione: capacità dimostrata di tradurre la strategia in priorità attuabili e fornire iniziative su larga scala con un impatto misurabile.

• Competenze del settore profondo: comprensione solida dei servizi post-trade, dinamica delle infrastrutture di mercato e ambiente normativo.

• Esperienza nei partenariati e M&A: esposizione manuale a partenariati strategici e crescita inorganica, tra cui sviluppo di casi aziendali e pianificazione di integrazione.

• Influenza e capacità di comunicazione: Capacità di coinvolgere e consigliare gli stakeholder anziani con credibilità; fluente in inglese (il tedesco è un forte vantaggio).

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Strategy & Business Development Securities Services

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8043

Do you want to shape the future of capital markets infrastructure in a highly dynamic environment? We seek a Head Strategy & Business Development for Securities Services , based in Zurich or Madrid, responsible for translating strategy into execution, driving growth initiatives, and leading partnerships and M&A efforts. Be part of a team that values ownership.

What You Will Do

• Translate Securities Service's strategy into actionable roadmaps, define outcomes, track execution, and mitigate risks proactively

• Advise executive leadership on priorities, resource allocation, and strategic decisions using structured insights

• Drive cross‑business growth across clearing, custody, securities finance, and trade repositories

• Build and oversee business-intelligence capabilities supporting data-driven business and strategic decisions.

• Own M&A workstreams and business cases, ensuring alignment with long‑term strategy and integration success

What You Bring

• Strong experience in strategy or consulting within exchanges or financial market infrastructures

• 10 years of relevant professional experience with a proven leadership track record building high‑performing teams during transformation and change programs

• Deep expertise in post‑trade services, market infrastructure, and regulatory and competitive dynamics

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑business initiatives and execute strategy with measurable outcomes

• Fluent English required, with strong communication skills; German and/or Spanish is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Head Strategy & Business Development Wertpapierdienstleistungen

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8043

Der Head of Business Development & Strategy gestaltet und liefert die Wachstumsagenda von SIX Securities Services. Die Rolle treibt transversale strategische Initiativen, neue Unternehmensgründungen, Partnerschaften und M&A-Möglichkeiten voran und stellt sicher, dass BSS als führender europäischer Post-Trade-Infrastrukturanbieter positioniert ist.

Sie ist über alle vertikalen Produktbereiche hinweg tätig und übersetzt die Strategie in die Umsetzung, erschließt neue Umsatzmöglichkeiten und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei der Steuerung der langfristigen Entwicklung des Geschäftsbereichs.

Was Sie tun werden

• Strategische Umsetzung vorantreiben: Übersetzen Sie die BSS-Strategie in klare Roadmaps, um disziplinierte Umsetzung, Risikomanagement und messbare Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Wachstumschancen identifizieren und liefern: Erweitern Sie Umsatzströme in den Bereichen Clearing, Depot, Wertpapierfinanzierung und Mehrwertdienste, einschließlich neuer Märkte und Kundensegmente.

• Führen Sie Partnerschaften und M&A-Initiativen: Entwickeln Sie strategische Partnerschaften und verwalten Sie anorganische Wachstumschancen von der Bewertung bis zur Integration.

• Beratung von Führungskräften: Bereitstellung strategischer Erkenntnisse, Business Cases und Performance Monitoring zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung auf Führungsebene.

• Gewährleistung einer funktionsübergreifenden Ausrichtung: Förderung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Geschäftsbereichen und Stärkung der Positionierung von SIX bei Kunden und im Kapitalmarkt-Ökosystem.

Was du mitbringst

• Umfangreiche Strategie- und Führungserfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in Unternehmensstrategie, Beratung oder Geschäftsentwicklung in Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen oder Kapitalmärkten.

• Starke Ausführungsorientierung: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Strategie in umsetzbare Prioritäten zu übersetzen und große Initiativen mit messbarer Wirkung zu liefern.

• Tiefe Branchenexpertise: Solides Verständnis von Nachhandelsdienstleistungen, Marktinfrastrukturdynamik und regulatorischem Umfeld.

• Erfahrung in Partnerschaften und M&A: Hands-on Exposition gegenüber strategischen Partnerschaften und anorganischem Wachstum, einschließlich Business Case Entwicklung und Integrationsplanung.

• Einfluss- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, hochrangige Stakeholder glaubwürdig zu engagieren und zu beraten; fließend Englisch (Deutsch ist ein großer Vorteil).

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Chef Stratégie et développement des entreprises Services de valeurs mobilières

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Le responsable du développement des entreprises et de la stratégie définit et fournit le programme de croissance de SIX Securities Services. Ce rôle est à l'origine d'initiatives stratégiques transversales, de nouvelles créations d'entreprises, de partenariats et de possibilités de fusions et acquisitions, ce qui permet à BSS de se positionner comme un fournisseur d'infrastructure post-négociation européen de premier plan.

Fonctionnant sur toutes les verticales de produits, elle traduit la stratégie en exécution, ouvre de nouvelles possibilités de revenus et aide les cadres supérieurs à diriger le développement à long terme de l'unité opérationnelle.

Ce que vous ferez

• Diriger l'exécution stratégique : Traduire la stratégie de SSC en feuilles de route claires, en assurant une prestation disciplinée, la gestion des risques et des résultats mesurables.

• Identifier et offrir des possibilités de croissance : Élargir les flux de revenus entre les services de compensation, de garde, de financement des valeurs mobilières et de valeur ajoutée, y compris les nouveaux marchés et les segments de clients.

• Diriger les partenariats et les initiatives de S et A : Élaborer des partenariats stratégiques et gérer les possibilités de croissance inorganique, de l'évaluation à l'intégration.

• Conseiller les cadres supérieurs : Fournir des conseils stratégiques, des analyses de rentabilisation et une surveillance du rendement pour appuyer la prise de décisions au niveau des cadres supérieurs.

• Assurer l'alignement interfonctionnel : favoriser la collaboration entre les unités commerciales et renforcer le positionnement de SIX avec les clients et au sein de l'écosystème des marchés financiers.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience approfondie en matière de stratégie et de leadership : Expérience éprouvée en matière de stratégie d'entreprise, de consultation ou de développement d'entreprise au sein des infrastructures des marchés financiers ou des marchés de capitaux.

• Forte concentration sur l'exécution : Capacité démontrée de traduire la stratégie en priorités réalisables et de réaliser des initiatives à grande échelle ayant un impact mesurable.

• Expertise approfondie de l'industrie : Compréhension solide des services post-négociation, de la dynamique des infrastructures de marché et de l'environnement réglementaire.

• Expérience des partenariats et des fusions-acquisitions : Exposition directe aux partenariats stratégiques et à la croissance inorganique, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation et la planification de l'intégration.

• Influence et compétences en communication : Capacité d'engager et de conseiller les principaux intervenants avec crédibilité; maîtrise de l'anglais (l'allemand est un fort avantage).

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Gestione account

Zurigo | 80-100% | Riferimento 8147

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente altamente dinamico? Sei appassionato di dati di mercato? Allora il nostro team di Gestione account vuole sentire da voi! Siamo un team AGILE, DRIVEN e internazionale responsabile della licenza dei dati di mercato sia in soggetti legali SIX che BME. In questa posizione lavorerai a stretto contatto con l'Amministrazione e l'Intelligence, la Giurisprudenza e le Operazioni.

Cosa farai

• Responsabile della gestione olistica e orientata al servizio dei clienti esistenti e nuovi nell'ambito della gestione dei conti proattivi.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per i clienti, coordinare i team interfunzionali (Product, Legal, Operations) per garantire la fornitura di servizi senza soluzione di continuità, monitorando le prestazioni del conto e allineando le soluzioni con le esigenze del cliente e gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni cliente sostenibili.

• Guidare la crescita commerciale attraverso upselling e cross-selling di servizi di dati di mercato e offerte di analisi a valore aggiunto.

• Avviare e sostenere gli audit dei clienti e assistere l'auditor esterno nella preparazione e nell'esecuzione delle attività di audit.

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza dimostrata nel settore dei servizi finanziari (3-8 anni).

• Sfondo solido nel dominio dei dati di mercato (ad esempio, fornitore di dati, scambio o banca).

• Esperienza nella gestione dei conti, vendite o gestione dei rapporti con i clienti.

• Forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (sia verbale che scritta), spagnolo o francese è un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Tedesco Lopez Arranz al +34 91 709 5771 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Account Manager

Zurich | 80-100% | Reference 8147

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about market data? Then our Account Management team wants to hear from you! We are an AGILE, DRIVEN and international team responsible for the licensing of market data across both legal entities SIX and BME. In this position you will work closely with Administration & Intelligence, Legal & Compliance and Operations.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the holistic and service-oriented management of existing and new clients within the framework of proactive account management.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for clients, coordinating cross-functional teams (Product, Legal, Operations) to ensure seamless service delivery, while monitoring account performance and aligning solutions with client needs and business objectives.

• Building and maintaining sustainable client relationships.

• Driving commercial growth through upselling and cross-selling of market data services and value-added analytics offerings.

• Initiate and support client audits and assisting the external auditor in the preparation and execution of audit activities.

What You Bring

• Proven experience in the financial services industry (3-8 years).

• Solid background in the market data domain (e.g. data vendor, exchange or bank).

• Experience in account management, sales, or client relationship management.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Fluent in German and English (both verbal & writing), Spanish or French is a plus.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Account Manager

Zürich | 80-100% | Referenz 8147

Möchten Sie in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld arbeiten? Sie interessieren sich für Marktdaten? Dann möchte unser Account Management Team von Ihnen hören! Wir sind ein AGILE, DRIVEN und ein internationales Team, das für die Lizenzierung von Marktdaten sowohl von SIX als auch von BME verantwortlich ist. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie eng mit Administration & Intelligence, Legal & Compliance und Operations zusammen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Verantwortlich für das ganzheitliche und serviceorientierte Management bestehender und neuer Kunden im Rahmen eines proaktiven Account Managements.

• Als primäre Anlaufstelle für Kunden, Koordination von funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Produkt, Recht, Betrieb), um eine nahtlose Servicebereitstellung zu gewährleisten, während die Kontoleistung überwacht und Lösungen an den Kundenbedürfnissen und Geschäftszielen ausgerichtet werden.

• Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen.

• Förderung des kommerziellen Wachstums durch Upselling und Cross-Selling von Marktdatendiensten und Value-Added-Analytics-Angeboten.

• Initiieren und unterstützen Sie Kundenaudits und unterstützen Sie den externen Auditor bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Auditaktivitäten.

Was du mitbringst

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche (3-8 Jahre).

• Solider Hintergrund im Marktdatenbereich (z. B. Datenlieferant, Börse oder Bank).

• Erfahrung in Account Management, Sales oder Client Relationship Management.

• Starkes Gefühl von Eigentum und Rechenschaftspflicht.

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch (sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich), Spanisch oder Französisch ist ein Plus.

Zurich (80-100%) Référence 8147

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement très dynamique ? Êtes-vous passionné par les données du marché? Alors, notre équipe de gestion de compte veut vous entendre ! • Responsable de la gestion globale et axée sur les services des clients existants et nouveaux dans le cadre de la gestion proactive des comptes.

• Entreprendre et appuyer les audits des clients et aider le vérificateur externe à préparer et à exécuter les activités de vérification.

• Expérience éprouvée dans le secteur des services financiers (3-8 ans).

• Fondement solide dans le domaine des données du marché (par exemple, fournisseur de données, échange ou banque).

• Expérience en gestion de compte, ventes ou gestion de relation client.
