SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Specialista delle operazioni finanziarie

Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa | Riferimento 8127

A SIX, questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di contribuire a un fornitore di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario leader garantendo la qualità e l'affidabilità dei dati di riferimento su fondi, reddito fisso e azioni. A seguito di una strutturata onboarding, la posizione si concentra sul mantenimento di dati accurati, sul supporto della conformità normativa e sulla fornitura di elevati standard di servizio ai clienti. Il ruolo combina le responsabilità analitiche con il supporto funzionale del cliente in un ambiente internazionale e guidato dai dati. È adatto per i candidati interessati ai mercati finanziari e ai processi fondamentali che li sostengono.

Cosa farai:

• inserire i dati di riferimento in SIX diversi database

• verificare la coerenza dei dati e eseguire controlli di secondo livello

• fornire assistenza funzionale ai clienti

Cosa porti:

• fluente francese parlando

• la prima esperienza nel settore dei dati finanziari o in un settore relativo è un plus

• conoscenza del fondo francese ed europeo/regolamenti sul reddito/condizioni fiscali

• comprensione dell'ecosistema di reddito/condizioni del fondo/Fixed (responsabili del mercato, sistemi di distribuzione dei dati, concetti di ufficio Back/Front)

• Conoscenza della lingua SQL è un plus

• livello di istruzione superiore nella gestione/finanza (di solito un master)

• forte interesse e passione per i mercati finanziari

• eccellenti capacità analitiche, autonomia, rigore e forte spirito di squadra

• capacità di lavorare in ambienti diversi e adattarsi a vari strumenti e tecnologie

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Financial Securities Specialist

Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home | Reference 8127

At SIX, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to a leading financial market infrastructure provider by ensuring the quality and reliability of reference data across funds, fixed income, and shares. Following a structured onboarding, the position focuses on maintaining accurate data, supporting regulatory compliance, and delivering high standards of service to clients. The role combines analytical responsibilities with functional client support in an international and data‑driven environment. It is well suited for candidates interested in financial markets and the core processes that support them.

What You Will Do:

• entering reference data into SIX different databases

• verifying data consistency and performing second-level checks

• providing functional assistance to clients

What You Bring:

• fluent French speaking

• first experience in the financial data industry or a related field is a plus

• knowledge of French and European fund/Fixed Income/Shares regulations

• understanding of the fund/Fixed Income/Shares ecosystem (market players, data distribution systems, Back/Front office concepts)

• SQL language knowledge is a plus

• higher education background in management/finance (ideally a Master’s degree)

• strong interest in and passion for financial markets

• excellent analytical skills, autonomy, rigor, and strong team spirit

• ability to work across diverse environments and adapt to various tools and technologies

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Spezialist für Finanzsicherheiten

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten | Referenz 8127

Bei SIX bietet diese Rolle die Möglichkeit, einen Beitrag zu einem führenden Anbieter von Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen zu leisten, indem die Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit von Referenzdaten über Fonds, Fixed Income und Aktien hinweg sichergestellt wird. Nach einem strukturierten Onboarding konzentriert sich die Position auf die Pflege genauer Daten, die Unterstützung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und die Bereitstellung hoher Servicestandards für Kunden. Die Rolle verbindet analytische Verantwortlichkeiten mit funktionaler Kundenbetreuung in einem internationalen und datengesteuerten Umfeld. Es eignet sich gut für Kandidaten, die sich für Finanzmärkte und die Kernprozesse interessieren, die sie unterstützen.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Eingabe von Referenzdaten in verschiedene Datenbanken von SIX

• Überprüfung der Datenkonsistenz und Durchführung von Prüfungen der zweiten Stufe

• Bereitstellung funktionaler Unterstützung für Kunden

Was Sie mitbringen:

• fließend Französisch sprechend

• erste Erfahrung in der Finanzdatenbranche oder einem verwandten Bereich ist ein Plus

• Kenntnis der französischen und europäischen Fonds/Fixed Income/Aktien-Vorschriften

• Verständnis des Ökosystems Fonds / Fixed Income / Shares (Marktakteure, Datenverteilungssysteme, Back / Front Office-Konzepte)

• SQL Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

• Hochschulhintergrund in Management / Finanzen (idealerweise ein Master-Abschluss)

• starkes Interesse und Leidenschaft für die Finanzmärkte

• exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten, Autonomie, Strenge und starker Teamgeist

• Fähigkeit, in verschiedenen Umgebungen zu arbeiten und sich an verschiedene Tools und Technologien anzupassen

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa an .

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste en valeurs financières

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40 % travaillent à domicile.

Chez SIX, ce rôle offre la possibilité de contribuer à un fournisseur d'infrastructure de marché financier de premier plan en assurant la qualité et la fiabilité des données de référence sur les fonds, les revenus fixes et les actions. À la suite d'un embarquement structuré, le poste est axé sur le maintien de données exactes, l'appui à la conformité réglementaire et la prestation de normes élevées de service aux clients. Ce rôle combine les responsabilités analytiques et le soutien fonctionnel des clients dans un environnement international et axé sur les données. Il convient parfaitement aux candidats intéressés par les marchés financiers et les processus de base qui les soutiennent.

Ce que vous ferez :

• saisie des données de référence dans SIX différentes bases de données

• vérifier la cohérence des données et effectuer des contrôles de deuxième niveau

• Fournir une assistance fonctionnelle aux clients

Ce que vous apportez:

• parler couramment français

• première expérience dans le secteur des données financières ou un domaine connexe est un plus

• connaissance de la réglementation française et européenne des fonds/revenus fixes/actions

• compréhension de l'écosystème fonds/revenus fixes/actions (acteurs du marché, systèmes de distribution de données, concepts back/Front office)

• La connaissance du langage SQL est un plus

• Études supérieures en gestion/finance (idéalement un master)

• fort intérêt et passion pour les marchés financiers

• excellentes compétences analytiques, autonomie, rigueur et esprit d'équipe

• Capacité de travailler dans divers environnements et de s'adapter à divers outils et technologies

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa à .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Security Platforms Engineer Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7629 Do you enjoy building and operating resilient, automated platforms that sit at the heart of security operations? Are you comfortable owning production systems, improving them through code, and thinking in terms of reliability, failure modes, and scale? We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations. Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams. The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential. What You Will Do
• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.
• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.
• Design and implement automation and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, enabling reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.
• Develop and maintain Python‑based tooling to automate workflows, integrate systems, and eliminate manual operational effort.
• Design, deploy, and operate workloads on container‑based platforms (Kubernetes / OpenShift) as a platform user, while supporting data pipelines (Elastic, logstash, Kafka) and collaborating with platform and security teams globally. What You Bring
• Core expectations (senior level):
• Strong experience in platform engineering / SRE / infrastructure roles , with end‑to‑end ownership of production systems .
• Proven expertise in Terraform, Git‑based CI/CD, and Python , designing and implementing automation in production environments .
• Practical experience working with Kubernetes platforms as a user , deploying and operating workloads reliably at scale.
• Experience with data‑intensive or security‑relevant platforms (Elastic Stack, Kafka, log pipelines, Splunk, Opensearch), including performance, scaling, and operational trade‑offs.
• Strong production mindset: experience with on‑call, incident response, and understanding of system failure modes , combined with a proactive, ownership‑driven approach. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. .buttontextc3db959

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Security Platforms Engineer

Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7629

Do you enjoy building and operating resilient, automated platforms that sit at the heart of security operations? Are you comfortable owning production systems, improving them through code, and thinking in terms of reliability, failure modes, and scale?

We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations.

Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams.

The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential.

What You Will Do

• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.

• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.

• Design and implement automation and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, enabling reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.

• Develop and maintain Python‑based tooling to automate workflows, integrate systems, and eliminate manual operational effort.

• Design, deploy, and operate workloads on container‑based platforms (Kubernetes / OpenShift) as a platform user, while supporting data pipelines (Elastic, logstash, Kafka) and collaborating with platform and security teams globally.

What You Bring

• Core expectations (senior level):

• Strong experience in platform engineering / SRE / infrastructure roles , with end‑to‑end ownership of production systems .

• Proven expertise in Terraform, Git‑based CI/CD, and Python , designing and implementing automation in production environments .

• Practical experience working with Kubernetes platforms as a user , deploying and operating workloads reliably at scale.

• Experience with data‑intensive or security‑relevant platforms (Elastic Stack, Kafka, log pipelines, Splunk, Opensearch), including performance, scaling, and operational trade‑offs.

• Strong production mindset: experience with on‑call, incident response, and understanding of system failure modes , combined with a proactive, ownership‑driven approach.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7801 At BME Exchange, we are looking for an experienced, customer-orientated business analyst to work on the business rollout of projects and enhancements to the SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange. Are you a flexible team player, passionate about implementing initiatives in an Agile framework environment? Are you motivated to learn about the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructure and securities trading and analyse how these are affected by new initiatives? This is your chance to experience the stock exchange from the inside, in a unique, fast paced, and inspiring environment. In this role you will participate in the creation of the common Spanish and Swiss trading platform, contributing to its functional development and market innovation. Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English! What You Will Do
• Coordinate and ensure changes are rolled out to clients seamlessly
• Write business documents, including interface specifications, and communications to support clients integrating changes into their internal systems
• Coordinate and perform acceptance tests for the Spanish Market and Exchanges platform (SMART), SIX Swiss Exchange and the future common Spanish and Swiss trading platform Equinox
• Analyze and assess business initiatives in Equity, Fixed Interest and Derivatives Trading
• Research for the impact of these changes on SSX and BME Regulatory documents and work with internal teams to ensure Regulators are informed of and approve changes in a timely manner What You Bring
• Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in financial services
• Ambition to work independently and take responsibility in a small team
• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods
• Strong analytical and conceptual reasoning and the ability to impart knowledge
• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English. German is a plus. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div class="inner " style="font-family:custom277b431a506746d

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7801

At BME Exchange, we are looking for an experienced, customer-orientated business analyst to work on the business rollout of projects and enhancements to the SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange. Are you a flexible team player, passionate about implementing initiatives in an Agile framework environment? Are you motivated to learn about the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructure and securities trading and analyse how these are affected by new initiatives?

This is your chance to experience the stock exchange from the inside, in a unique, fast paced, and inspiring environment. In this role you will participate in the creation of the common Spanish and Swiss trading platform, contributing to its functional development and market innovation.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Coordinate and ensure changes are rolled out to clients seamlessly

• Write business documents, including interface specifications, and communications to support clients integrating changes into their internal systems

• Coordinate and perform acceptance tests for the Spanish Market and Exchanges platform (SMART), SIX Swiss Exchange and the future common Spanish and Swiss trading platform Equinox

• Analyze and assess business initiatives in Equity, Fixed Interest and Derivatives Trading

• Research for the impact of these changes on SSX and BME Regulatory documents and work with internal teams to ensure Regulators are informed of and approve changes in a timely manner

What You Bring

• Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in financial services

• Ambition to work independently and take responsibility in a small team

• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods

• Strong analytical and conceptual reasoning and the ability to impart knowledge

• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English. German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Information Security Officer Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7942 Information security is a key requirement for the successful and compliant operation of Securities Services. As a Business Information Security Officer (BISO), you act as the main point of contact for information security topics within Securities Services, supporting the appropriate handling of security risks, regulatory obligations, and internal security requirements in line with SIX standards. Are you passionate about data, technology, and making a meaningful impact? Join our Data Analytics team and help shape the future of data and analytics for our Exchanges Business Unit. • Strong experience working with Databricks, Azure, Python, PySpark, and Azure Data Factory

• Familiarity with CI/CD and a detail-oriented, ownership-driven mindset

Sie nehmen aktiv an Testumgebungen teil, arbeiten mit IT- und Entwicklungsteams zusammen, um neue Funktionalitäten zu validieren, und leiten Initiativen zur Optimierung von Workflows und zur Reduzierung von Betriebsrisiken. Wenn Sie Erfahrung in Finanzmarktoperationen, starke analytische Fähigkeiten und eine proaktive Denkweise haben, die sich auf Exzellenz konzentriert, ist diese Position für Sie.

Sind Sie daran interessiert, einem dynamischen Team beizutreten und zur Entwicklung unserer Plattformen beizutragen?

Was Sie tun werden

• Beaufsichtigen Sie das tägliche Funktionieren und überwachen Sie den Betrieb sowohl der FX-Handels- als auch der Abwicklungsplattformen, gewährleisten Sie Stabilität, Effizienz und Genauigkeit in allen Prozessen und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Prozessoptimierung und Workflow-Automatisierung.

• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an den Testumgebungen beider Plattformen und arbeiten Sie mit IT-Teams zusammen, um neue Releases, Funktionen und Korrekturen vor der Bereitstellung der Produktion zu validieren.

• Gewährleistung, dass alle operativen Tätigkeiten den internen Verfahren und geltenden Vorschriften entsprechen, und Beitrag zur Erstellung von Berichten und Aktualisierungen, die von den Aufsichtsorganen in Bezug auf die Systemleistung und die wichtigsten operationellen Indikatoren verlangt werden.

• Unterstützung und Überwachung des Onboardings und der Aktivität neuer Kunden aus operativer Sicht

Was du mitbringst

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Finanzmarktoperationen oder Nachhandelsumgebungen.

• Erfahrung in einer Qualitätssicherungs- oder Betriebsrolle, einschließlich Test- oder UAT-Prozessen (User Acceptance Testing) innerhalb von Finanzsystemen, wird hoch geschätzt.

• Starke analytische, problemlösende, kommunikative Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, über mehrere Teams zu koordinieren.

• Proaktive Einstellung, Liebe zum Detail und die Fähigkeit, in einem kleinen, kollaborativen Team zu arbeiten.

• Effektive mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Business Englisch und Spanisch.

Spécialiste des opérations FX

Madrid: Travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8275

Êtes-vous passionné par l'amélioration continue et la qualité dans les environnements financiers?

SIX a récemment lancé un projet innovant visant à transformer le fonctionnement des entités financières sur Forex Markets. Vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique et contribuer à l'évolution de nos plateformes ?

Ce que vous ferez

• Surveiller le fonctionnement quotidien et surveiller les opérations des plates-formes de négociation et de règlement FX, assurer la stabilité, l'efficacité et l'exactitude de tous les processus, et identifier les possibilités d'optimisation des processus et d'automatisation des workflows.

• Soutenir et superviser l'intégration et l'activité des nouveaux clients du point de vue opérationnel

Ce que vous apportez

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans les opérations sur les marchés financiers ou les environnements post-négociations.

• L'expérience d'un rôle d'assurance de la qualité ou d'exploitation, y compris des tests ou des tests d'acceptation par l'utilisateur, au sein des systèmes financiers, est très appréciée.

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes, de communication et de coordination entre plusieurs équipes.

• Attitude proactive, attention aux détails et capacité de travailler dans une petite équipe collaborative.

• Compétences efficaces en communication orale et écrite en anglais des affaires et en espagnol.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Yuliya Stoyko au +34 917095993 .

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer

Madrid | 100 | Reference 8248

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment and build reliable, scalable backend systems? Are you passionate about Java, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures? Then our Backend Engineering Team wants to hear from you.

We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for designing and operating core backend services that power our platform in the Post Trading area of the SIX Swiss Exchange. Our goal is to build & maintain robust, scalable, and maintainable systems that support critical business processes.

In this position, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, maintain and deliver high-quality backend solutions.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot

• Build and operate event-driven services using Apache Kafka

• Develop and maintain applications running on Java application servers such as WildFly

• Collaborate with engineers and architects on system design, architecture, and technical improvements

• Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems

What You Bring

• Very strong experience with Java backend development and modern backend design principles

• Experience with Spring and Spring Boot for building microservices

• Experience with Kafka or other messaging / event-streaming platforms

• Experience with Wildfly/JBOSS is a big plus

• Experience designing RESTful APIs and working with SQL databases

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call German Lopez Arranz at +34 91 709 5771 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in english.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Head Product Management Funds

London | Hybrid 60-40% | Reference 8243

Introduction
SIX is a leading provider of financial information, data services and related solutions for the financial services industry. We are seeking an experienced product leader to head the Funds Product Management function within SIX Financial Information. Reporting directly to the Head Product & Commercial Strategy, you will lead a team of Senior Product Managers and subject matter experts, shaping the strategic direction of our Funds proposition, driving commercial growth, and ensuring our offerings remain highly relevant, differentiated and aligned with evolving client and market needs.

What You Will Do

• Define and execute the Funds product, content and commercial strategy, roadmap and proposition, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client demand and regulatory developments.
• Drive revenue growth by strengthening market positioning, enhancing proposition clarity, supporting Sales teams and increasing client engagement across target markets.
• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from market opportunity identification and business case development through to product launch, performance management and retirement.
• Simplify and optimise the Funds product portfolio by supporting end-of-life decisions for legacy services and integrating valuable capabilities into the strategic Funds offering.
• Establish and deliver strategic objectives for content sourcing, data quality, service levels and automation, while reducing dependency on third-party providers through increased direct sourcing.
• Partner closely with Data Operations, Technology, Business and IT Architecture teams to optimise operating models, improve organisational effectiveness and lead a high-performing team of Senior Product Managers and SMEs.

What You Will Bring

• Significant experience in product management, product strategy or commercial product leadership within financial information, funds, asset management, wealth management or related data services.
• Strong understanding of the Funds ecosystem, including market structure, client workflows, data sourcing, quality management, service delivery and regulatory requirements.
• Proven ability to translate market opportunities into compelling product propositions, investment cases, commercial priorities and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience leading expert product teams and influencing senior stakeholders across product, operations, technology, sales and executive leadership functions.
• Excellent communication, commercial judgement and strategic decision-making skills, with the ability to drive focus, scalability and long-term client value.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 .

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a dare forma al futuro della finanza con noi.

Responsabile Architettura aziendale

Londra, Zurigo | Ibrido 60-40% | Riferimento 8233

Introduzione
In qualità di responsabile dell'architettura aziendale presso SIX Financial Information, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel definire l'evoluzione strategica delle nostre piattaforme di dati finanziari. Lavorando a stretto contatto con dirigenti aziendali senior, architettura IT e team tecnologici, tradurrai la strategia aziendale in iniziative di trasformazione tangibili che guidano la crescita, l'innovazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Riportando e collaborando con Head Product & Commercial Strategy, guiderai un team di Business Architect, sosterrai la pianificazione basata sulle capacità e contribuirai a modernizzare la fornitura di prodotti di informazioni finanziarie critiche attraverso i nostri pilastri di contenuti principali, tra cui Indici, Fondi, Reddito fisso, Dati di riferimento e Dati di mercato. Agendo come consulente strategico di fiducia, collaborerai a stretto contatto con l'architettura IT e colmerai il divario tra business e tecnologia, assicurando che gli investimenti sulla piattaforma siano in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine e le esigenze dei clienti.

Cosa farai

• Guidare, guidare e sviluppare un team ad alte prestazioni di specialisti di architetti aziendali, promuovendo una cultura di collaborazione, innovazione e miglioramento continuo.
• Tradurre la strategia aziendale in artefatti fruibili dell'architettura aziendale, inclusi flussi di valore, mappe di processi, modelli operativi aziendali e una narrazione strategica e roadmap di accompagnamento.
• In stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'architettura IT, contribuire allo sviluppo e all'evoluzione dei modelli di capacità aziendali e delle roadmap strategiche congiunte che collegano strategia ed esecuzione
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con l'architettura IT e i leader aziendali per identificare e promuovere opportunità di trasformazione che migliorino le piattaforme dati e le capacità di distribuzione.
• Condurre valutazioni di piattaforme, processi e modelli operativi esistenti, comprese analisi SWOT funzionali e supportare valutazioni build-versus-buy, per supportare il processo decisionale strategico.
• Sviluppare casi aziendali convincenti e raccomandazioni a livello esecutivo che supportino le decisioni di investimento e le iniziative di trasformazione aziendale.
• Collaborare con le parti interessate interne e i fornitori esterni per valutare le tecnologie emergenti, integrare soluzioni di terze parti e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro all'interno dell'organizzazione.

Cosa porterai

• Vasta esperienza nel settore dell'informazione finanziaria, con una profonda conoscenza dei dati di mercato, dei dati di riferimento, delle azioni societarie e delle piattaforme di dati finanziari.
• Comprovato successo nello sviluppo e nell'applicazione di strutture e modelli strutturati, tra cui la mappatura del flusso di valore, modelli operativi aziendali e metodologie di pianificazione strategica.
• Comprensione del panorama tecnologico aziendale, degli approcci di integrazione dei dati (API, SFTP) e dei moderni programmi di trasformazione della piattaforma.
• Eccezionali capacità di gestione e influenza degli stakeholder, con la capacità di coinvolgere e sfidare dirigenti senior, leader tecnologici e team interfunzionali.
• Eccezionali capacità analitiche e di pensiero strategico, con un track record nel tradurre sfide aziendali complesse in soluzioni pratiche e raccomandazioni chiare.
• Uno stile di leadership collaborativo, con una comprovata esperienza di collaborazione con le funzioni di architettura e tecnologia IT, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e presentazione e la capacità di ispirare i team guidando al tempo stesso il cambiamento organizzativo e i risultati aziendali.

In caso di domande, consulta la nostra pagina delle domande frequenti o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Business Architecture

London, Zurich | Hybrid 60-40% | Reference 8233

Introduction
As Head of Business Architecture at SIX Financial Information, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic evolution of our financial data platforms. Working closely with senior business leaders, IT Architecture, and technology teams, you will translate business strategy into tangible transformation initiatives that drive growth, innovation, and operational excellence. Reporting into and working with Head Product & Commercial Strategy, you will lead a team of Business Architects, champion capability-driven planning, and help modernise the delivery of critical financial information products across our core content pillars, including Index, Funds, Fixed Income, Reference Data, and Market Data. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor, you will partner closely with IT Architecture and bridge the gap between business and technology, ensuring that platform investments align with long-term business objectives and customer needs.

What You Will Do

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Business Architects Specialists, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Translate business strategy into actionable business architecture artefacts, including value streams, process maps, business operating models and a strategic narrative and accompanying roadmaps.
• In close partnership with Head of IT Architecture, contribute to the development and evolution of business capability models and joint strategic roadmaps that bridge strategy and execution
• Partner closely with IT Architecture and business leaders to identify and drive transformation opportunities that enhance data platforms and delivery capabilities.
• Conduct assessments of existing platforms, processes, and operating models, including functional SWOT analyses and supporting build-versus-buy evaluations, to support strategic decision-making.
• Develop compelling business cases and executive-level recommendations that support investment decisions and enterprise transformation initiatives.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to evaluate emerging technologies, integrate third-party solutions, and optimise workflows across the organisation.

What You Will Bring

• Extensive experience within the financial information industry, with deep expertise in market data, reference data, corporate actions, and financial data platforms.
• Proven success in developing and applying structured frameworks and models, including value stream mapping, business operating models, and strategic planning methodologies.
• Understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, data integration approaches (APIs, SFTP), and modern platform transformation programmes.
• Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and challenge senior executives, technology leaders, and cross-functional teams.
• Outstanding analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a track record of translating complex business challenges into practical solutions and clear recommendations.
• A collaborative leadership style, with a proven track record of partnering with IT Architecture and Technology functions, excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to inspire teams while driving organisational change and business outcomes.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokaler Verwurzelung und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft des Finanzwesens.

Leiter Geschäftsarchitektur

London, Zürich | Hybrid 60-40 % | Referenz 8233

Einführung
Als Head of Business Architecture bei SIX Financial Information spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der strategischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Finanzdatenplattformen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Unternehmensleitern, IT-Architektur- und Technologieteams setzen Sie die Geschäftsstrategie in konkrete Transformationsinitiativen um, die Wachstum, Innovation und operative Exzellenz vorantreiben. Sie berichten an den Head Product & Commercial Strategy und arbeiten mit ihm zusammen. Sie leiten ein Team von Business Architects, setzen sich für eine fähigkeitsorientierte Planung ein und helfen bei der Modernisierung der Bereitstellung wichtiger Finanzinformationsprodukte über unsere Kerninhaltssäulen hinweg, einschließlich Index, Fonds, festverzinsliche Wertpapiere, Referenzdaten und Marktdaten. Als vertrauenswürdiger strategischer Berater arbeiten Sie eng mit der IT-Architektur zusammen und schließen die Lücke zwischen Geschäft und Technologie. So stellen Sie sicher, dass Plattforminvestitionen mit langfristigen Geschäftszielen und Kundenbedürfnissen im Einklang stehen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Führen, betreuen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von Business Architects-Spezialisten und fördern Sie eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.
• Übersetzen Sie die Geschäftsstrategie in umsetzbare Geschäftsarchitekturartefakte, einschließlich Wertströme, Prozesskarten, Geschäftsbetriebsmodelle sowie eine strategische Erzählung und begleitende Roadmaps.
• Tragen Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leiter der IT-Architektur zur Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsfähigkeitsmodellen und gemeinsamen strategischen Roadmaps bei, die Strategie und Umsetzung verbinden
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit IT-Architektur- und Unternehmensleitern zusammen, um Transformationsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und voranzutreiben, die Datenplattformen und Bereitstellungsmöglichkeiten verbessern.
• Führen Sie Bewertungen bestehender Plattformen, Prozesse und Betriebsmodelle durch, einschließlich funktionaler SWOT-Analysen und unterstützender Build-versus-Buy-Bewertungen, um die strategische Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.
• Entwickeln Sie überzeugende Business Cases und Empfehlungen auf Führungsebene, die Investitionsentscheidungen und Unternehmenstransformationsinitiativen unterstützen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Anbietern zusammen, um neue Technologien zu bewerten, Lösungen von Drittanbietern zu integrieren und Arbeitsabläufe im gesamten Unternehmen zu optimieren.

Was Sie mitbringen werden

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Finanzinformationsbranche mit fundiertem Fachwissen in Marktdaten, Referenzdaten, Kapitalmaßnahmen und Finanzdatenplattformen.
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Anwendung strukturierter Frameworks und Modelle, einschließlich der Abbildung von Wertströmen, Geschäftsmodellen und strategischen Planungsmethoden.
• Verständnis für Unternehmenstechnologielandschaften, Datenintegrationsansätze (APIs, SFTP) und moderne Plattformtransformationsprogramme.
• Außergewöhnliche Stakeholder-Management- und Einflussfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte, Technologieführer und funktionsübergreifende Teams einzubeziehen und herauszufordern.
• Hervorragende analytische und strategische Denkfähigkeiten mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung komplexer geschäftlicher Herausforderungen in praktische Lösungen und klare Empfehlungen.
• Ein kollaborativer Führungsstil mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Architektur- und Technologiefunktionen, hervorragenden Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren und gleichzeitig organisatorische Veränderungen und Geschäftsergebnisse voranzutreiben.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, schauen Sie sich unsere FAQ-Seite an oder rufen Sie Anthony Mills unter +44 207 550 5407 an.

Für diese Stelle nehmen wir ausschließlich Direktbewerbungen entgegen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX pilote la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir de la finance avec nous.

Responsable de l'architecture d'entreprise

Londres, Zurich | Hybride 60-40% | Référence 8233

Introduction
En tant que responsable de l'architecture commerciale chez SIX Financial Information, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'élaboration de l'évolution stratégique de nos plateformes de données financières. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les hauts dirigeants de l'entreprise, les équipes d'architecture informatique et de technologie, vous traduirez la stratégie commerciale en initiatives de transformation tangibles qui stimulent la croissance, l'innovation et l'excellence opérationnelle. Relevant du responsable des produits et de la stratégie commerciale et travaillant avec lui, vous dirigerez une équipe d'architectes commerciaux, défendrez la planification axée sur les capacités et contribuerez à moderniser la fourniture de produits d'information financière critiques sur nos principaux piliers de contenu, notamment les indices, les fonds, les titres à revenu fixe, les données de référence et les données de marché. En tant que conseiller stratégique de confiance, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'architecture informatique et comblerez le fossé entre l'entreprise et la technologie, en veillant à ce que les investissements dans la plate-forme correspondent aux objectifs commerciaux à long terme et aux besoins des clients.

Ce que vous ferez

• Diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe hautement performante de spécialistes en architecture d'affaires, favorisant une culture de collaboration, d'innovation et d'amélioration continue.
• Traduire la stratégie commerciale en artefacts d'architecture commerciale exploitables, y compris les flux de valeur, les cartes de processus, les modèles opérationnels commerciaux, ainsi qu'un récit stratégique et les feuilles de route qui l'accompagnent.
• En étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'architecture informatique, contribuer au développement et à l'évolution des modèles de capacités commerciales et des feuilles de route stratégiques communes qui relient la stratégie et l'exécution.
• Collaborer étroitement avec l'architecture informatique et les dirigeants d'entreprise pour identifier et piloter les opportunités de transformation qui améliorent les plateformes de données et les capacités de livraison.
• Mener des évaluations des plates-formes, des processus et des modèles opérationnels existants, y compris des analyses SWOT fonctionnelles et des évaluations de construction par rapport à l'achat, pour soutenir la prise de décision stratégique.
• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation convaincantes et des recommandations au niveau de la direction qui soutiennent les décisions d'investissement et les initiatives de transformation de l'entreprise.
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs externes pour évaluer les technologies émergentes, intégrer des solutions tierces et optimiser les flux de travail dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Ce que vous apporterez

• Vaste expérience dans le secteur de l'information financière, avec une expertise approfondie des données de marché, des données de référence, des opérations sur titres et des plateformes de données financières.
• Succès avéré dans le développement et l'application de cadres et de modèles structurés, y compris la cartographie de la chaîne de valeur, les modèles opérationnels commerciaux et les méthodologies de planification stratégique.
• Compréhension des paysages technologiques d'entreprise, des approches d'intégration de données (API, SFTP) et des programmes de transformation de plateforme modernes.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière de gestion des parties prenantes et d'influence, avec la capacité d'impliquer et de défier les cadres supérieurs, les leaders technologiques et les équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Capacités exceptionnelles de réflexion analytique et stratégique, avec une expérience dans la traduction de défis commerciaux complexes en solutions pratiques et en recommandations claires.
• Un style de leadership collaboratif, avec une expérience avérée en matière de partenariat avec des fonctions d'architecture et de technologie informatiques, d'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, et la capacité d'inspirer les équipes tout en pilotant le changement organisationnel et les résultats commerciaux.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Anthony Mills au +44 207 550 5407.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des candidatures indépendamment de toute expérience personnelle.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

AI Engineer - Test Automation & Guardrails

Madrid | 100 | Referencia 8247

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. We're building a new team at the center of this shift, responsible for shaping how AI-driven software engineering works across the company. As part of this team, you will build the guardrails that make agentic development trustworthy at scale: the test automation, coverage enforcement, and independent review layers that let AI agents write and ship code without compromising quality.

What You Will Do

• build test automation as a platform capability, not a project. Agent-driven test generation and maintenance, coverage enforcement on changed lines, flaky-test detection and self-healing, mutation testing, and test-suite health (redundancy, gaps, execution time) across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers.

• build and operate the AI agent harness. The sandboxed execution environment, tool/permission scoping, and CI/CD integration that lets agents propose, test, and merge code, instrumented with decision logs and action provenance so every agentic change is traceable and reproducible.

• own the independent review layer for AI-generated code and tests: correctness, coverage, and quality gates in CI/CD that verify what an agent produces using tooling the agent doesn't control, so speed never comes at the cost of test quality or code health.

• define and evolve the test strategy for an AI-driven SDLC. What gets tested where, how test data is generated and managed, and how test quality is measured (not just pass/fail, but whether the tests catch regressions).

• treat test automation and guardrails as a product, not a gate. Instrument for adoption, false-positive rate, and developer trust, keeping the safe, well-tested path the fastest path.

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software engineering with deep, hands-on expertise in test automation. Ideally a software/platform engineer in test, with a track record of building tooling or developer infrastructure that other engineering teams adopted, not just writing test suites.

• hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures. Agent orchestration, tool-use/sandboxing, and harness design, not just conceptual awareness of "AI in the SDLC."

• deep knowledge of test methodology and code quality: test pyramids, coverage strategy, mutation testing, flaky-test remediation, and what makes a test suite trustworthy versus just green.

• platform-product mindset. You build reusable capabilities and pave roads for other engineers, and you measure and strive for adoption and impact across SIX's business units.

• working knowledge of governance and controls in a regulated or high-assurance setting. Financial market infrastructure experience is a plus, but adjacent regulated-industry background is a plus. A pragmatic, collaborative bias toward quality and automation.

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Mercati finanziari Ricerca e Contenuto Specialista

Barcellona | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8202

Sei interessato a trasformare la ricerca sul mercato finanziario in contenuti che aiutano i clienti e gli stakeholder a comprendere il cambiamento? Il team Marketing Content sviluppa pubblicazioni guidate dalla ricerca e attività di marketing che collegano gli sviluppi del mercato, la regolamentazione, la tecnologia e le esigenze dei clienti in SIX.

In questo ruolo, si unirà la ricerca del settore finanziario con capacità editoriali e di contenuto. Identificherai argomenti rilevanti, analizzerai le prove e trasformerai i risultati complessi in report chiari, leadership di pensiero e contenuti di marketing riutilizzabili. Lavorando con esperti in tutto il business, si contribuirà a rafforzare la posizione di SIX in infrastrutture di mercato finanziario, dati e servizi attraverso narrazioni accurate e focalizzate sul pubblico.

Ti sembra interessante? Non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Identificare le opportunità di ricerca e contenuti monitorando i mercati finanziari, le esigenze dei clienti, gli sviluppi normativi, le tendenze tecnologiche e le priorità strategiche di SIX.

• Condurre ricerche indipendenti utilizzando competenze interne, fonti pubbliche, studi di settore e dataset rilevanti, e valutare le implicazioni per i partecipanti al mercato finanziario e le imprese di SIX.

• Trasformare i risultati della ricerca e complessi argomenti finanziari, normativi e tecnici in rapporti chiari, basati su prove, leadership di pensiero e contenuti di marketing adattati a diversi pubblici e canali.

• Gli esperti del settore intervista e collaborano con specialisti del prodotto, del business, dei dati e delle normative per sviluppare punti di vista, convalidare i risultati e garantire la rilevanza aziendale.

• Gestire le pubblicazioni dal concetto iniziale alla consegna, coordinare le proposte editoriali, la redazione, le recensioni degli stakeholder, il controllo della qualità e il riutilizzo attraverso campagne e comunicazioni orientate al cliente.

• Utilizzare strumenti abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per supportare la ricerca e la produzione di contenuti, mantenendo la precisione, la coerenza, la qualità e la conformità.

Che cosa porta

• Laurea o master in economia, finanza, mercati finanziari, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato.

• Almeno 4 anni di esperienza nella ricerca di mercato finanziario, contenuti finanziari, leadership di pensiero, giornalismo finanziario, consulenza o servizi finanziari, con esempi di pubblicazioni analitiche o studi di mercato.

• Conoscenza solida dei mercati dei capitali e delle infrastrutture del mercato finanziario, con competenze in diversi settori quali ecosistemi di scambio, dati di mercato, post-commercializzazione, pagamenti, infrastrutture bancarie, struttura di mercato o regolamentazione finanziaria europea.

• Forte ricerca e capacità analitiche, compresa la capacità di valutare le fonti, interpretare i dati finanziari, collegare i risultati alla pertinenza del cliente e del business e lavorare con le piattaforme di dati.

• Competenze di scrittura, editing e storytelling chiare, combinate con le capacità di stakeholder e project management e la capacità di trasformare l'ingresso specialistico in contenuti accessibili, accurati e focalizzati sul pubblico.

• Alto livello sia in inglese che in spagnolo, scritto e parlato.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 .

What You Will Do

• Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, standardization, and process enhancements, ensuring adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards in all treasury activities.

Analizzatore di intelligenza minaccia Cyber

• 4 anni di esperienza in Cyber Threat Intelligence, risposta agli incidenti, SOC, o relativi ruoli di sicurezza informatica tecnica.

• Forte profilo tecnico con esperienza pratica nell'automazione, nella scrittura o nell'orchestrazione

• Familiarità con le applicazioni AI in sicurezza informatica, in particolare per l'automazione, l'elaborazione dei dati, l'analisi e il miglioramento del flusso di lavoro di intelligenza.

• Esperienza con Threat Intelligence Platforms e strumenti di monitoraggio della sicurezza, tra cui OpenCTI, Elastic stack, piattaforme SIEM o tecnologie simili.

• Solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dell'intelligenza, dell'analisi della telemetria, della raccolta di informazioni tattiche e delle strutture come MITRE ATT&CK per il rilevamento e l'analisi delle minacce

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8095

We are seeking a motivated Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst with a strong technical mindset to support the intelligence collection, automation and maturation of our intelligence capabilities.

The focus of this role in Cyber Threat Intelligence is to enhance cyber threat intelligence capabilities through automation, AI-driven analysis, and continuous improvement of telemetry and intelligence workflows. You will work closely with senior team members and partners to enhance the company's intelligence capabilities.

This position is available only in Spain due to the restrictions of some of the intelligence sources.

What You Will Do

• Join an international Cyber Threat Intelligence team operating 24x7, including on-call availability when required.

• Monitor, collect, and analyze intelligence from restricted communities, internal telemetry, and monitoring systems to identify actionable insights and support investigations, incident response, and threat detection activities.

• Own and continuously improve weekly intelligence telemetry reporting, dashboards, and visualization capabilities to provide accurate, consistent, and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Contribute to the automation and orchestration of CTI workflows, including data collection, enrichment, analysis, reporting, and the integration of AI-driven capabilities for correlation, prioritization, and analytical output generation.

• Work with Threat Intelligence Platforms and security tooling, including OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms, and malware sandboxes, while applying frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to contextualize threats and improve detection effectiveness.

• Collaborate with SOC, Detection & Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Corporate Security, and other cross-functional teams to operationalize intelligence insights, produce threat reports and executive summaries, and support the continuous improvement and scalability of CTI processes.

What You Bring

• 4 years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, incident response, SOC, or related technical cybersecurity roles.

• Strong technical profile with hands-on experience in automation, scripting, or orchestration

• Familiarity with AI applications in cybersecurity, particularly for automation, data processing, analytics, and intelligence workflow improvement.

• Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms and security monitoring tools, including OpenCTI, Elastic stack, SIEM platforms, or similar technologies.

• Solid understanding of the intelligence lifecycle, telemetry analysis, tactical intelligence collection, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK for threat detection and analysis

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Risk Data & Analytics Engineer

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8226

Are you interested in the intersection of financial markets, risk management, and data engineering? Do you enjoy building scalable data solutions and automated processes that enable risk-informed decision-making? If so, this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to group‑wide risk management at the core of the organization.
The Risk Methodology & Reporting unit plays a central role in shaping the global risk framework and advancing the risk data infrastructure. The team develops and operates the risk data platform and delivers high‑quality, decision‑relevant reporting to senior management and external stakeholders. We offer an attractive Microsoft Azure and Databricks-based technology stack, providing opportunities to work with modern data engineering frameworks, scalable cloud architectures, and the latest AI technologies.
In this role, you will work with a team of highly motivated, self‑driven specialists at the crossroads of risk analytics, financial market infrastructures, and state-of-the-art IT systems.

Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Develop and enhance the Group’s risk data platform, data pipelines, and reporting capabilities.

• Translate complex risk data into decision‑relevant insights and dashboards

• Drive automation and scalability of risk data processing and analytics workflows

• Act as a key interface between Risk, IT, and Business functions to deliver data-driven solutions

• Take ownership of selected areas and drive the further development of group‑wide risk analytics capabilities

• Design and enhance data pipelines, automate risk data processes, and support the delivery of reliable risk information for decision-making

What You Bring

• Degree in Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related field, with relevant professional experience in risk management, data engineering & analytics, or financial services

• Strong ability to structure and communicate complex topics for senior stakeholders, with a self‑driven working style and a high level of ownership and accountability

• Proven +4 years of hands‑on experience with data engineering & analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Spark, PowerBI); experience with Databricks and MS Azure is a strong plus

• Conceptual strength with the ability to link analytical results to business and risk implications

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Spanish and/or German are an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Analizzatore di software senior & Sviluppatore Madrid, Barcellona | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8109 Partecipa al nostro team e gioca un ruolo chiave nella definizione del futuro dei servizi europei di compensazione. Come Software Analyst & Developer, lavorerai al centro di un ecosistema business-critical Clearing, supportando ed evolvendo applicazioni complesse, contribuendo allo sviluppo di una piattaforma di Clearing unificata di nuova generazione, lavorando con Oracle, PL/SQL, Java e architetture moderne. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire la stabilità, le prestazioni e l'evoluzione di un ecosistema finanziario complesso in un ambiente internazionale. L'assunzione potrebbe essere a Madrid o a Barcellona. Cosa farai
• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dell'ecosistema delle applicazioni di Clearing, compresi i flussi di core business, i modelli di dati e le dipendenze di sistema.
• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere robuste soluzioni PL/SQL per supportare i processi di Clearing critici, garantendo prestazioni, scalabilità e affidabilità.
• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e risolvere complessi incidenti di produzione, agendo come parte del modello di supporto L3 per applicazioni business-critical.
• Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare correzioni permanenti per prevenire la ricorrenza, contribuendo alla stabilità del sistema e al miglioramento continuo.
• Partecipa alle attività di supporto al di fuori delle ore di lavoro, compresa la risoluzione di incidenti ad alta priorità che interessano le operazioni di compensazione.
• Collaborare con architetti e team ingegneristici per evolvere sistemi legacy, contribuendo a iniziative di modernizzazione e integrazione con nuove architetture (ad esempio microservizi).
• Contribuisci alla documentazione tecnica, alla condivisione delle conoscenze e ai processi di consegna, garantendo una manutenbilità a lungo termine e l'autonomia del team.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali, le operazioni e i team di rischio per garantire un funzionamento efficiente e conforme dei servizi di Clearing.
• Contribuisci alla ri-architettura, all'analisi e allo sviluppo della piattaforma di compensazione di nuova generazione, supportando l'integrazione e il consolidamento dei sistemi di compensazione europea in un ecosistema unificato. Che cosa porta
• Forte competenza nei database Oracle e sviluppo avanzato di PL/SQL, con comprovata esperienza nell'elaborazione e nell'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni complesse.
• Sfondo solido in applicazione e architettura di sistema, soprattutto in ambienti legacy complessi.
• La comprensione del dominio business Clearing sarà un plus
• Esperienza con Java (architettura dei microservizi) e ambienti Linux.
• Spagnolo nativo e livello avanzato di inglese (C1), sia scritto che parlato.
• Disponibilità per svolgere attività di supporto pianificate al di fuori dell'orario di lavoro standard, quando necessario. Questo e' extra compensato.
• Volontà di partecipare a una rotazione di supporto 24/7 on-call, che copre settimane complete (circa una settimana al mese) e per coprire alcune festività bancarie (prox. 6 all'anno). Questi servizi sono extra compensati. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior PL/SQL Analyst

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8109

Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of European Clearing services. As aSenior PL/SQL Analyst, you will work at the heart of a business-critical Clearing ecosystem, supporting and evolving complex applications while contributing to the development of a next-generation, unified Clearing platform, working with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java, and modern architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and evolution of a complex financial ecosystem in an international environment. The hiring could be either in Madrid or in Barcelona.

What You Will Do

• Develop a deep understanding of the Clearing applications ecosystem, including core business flows, data models, and system dependencies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust PL/SQL solutions to support critical Clearing processes, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, acting as part of the L3 support model for business-critical applications.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence, contributing to system stability and continuous improvement.

• Participate in support activities outside business hours, including resolution of high-priority incidents affecting Clearing operations.

• Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to evolve legacy systems, contributing to modernization initiatives and integration with new architectures (e.g., microservices).

• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and handover processes, ensuring long-term maintainability and team autonomy.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, operations, and risk teams to ensure efficient and compliant operation of Clearing services.

• Contribute to the re-architecture, analysis and development of the next-generation Clearing platform, supporting the integration and consolidation of European Clearing systems into a unified ecosystem.

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in Oracle databases and advanced PL/SQL development, with proven experience in complex data processing and performance optimization.

• Solid background in application and system architecture, especially in complex legacy environments.

• Understanding of the Clearing business domain will be a plus

• Some experience with Java (microservices architecture) and Linux environments will be highly valuable.

• Good level of Spanish and English (B2 minimum), both written and spoken.

• Availability to perform planned support activities outside standard working hours, when required. This is extra compensated.

• Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation, covering full weeks (approximately one week per month) and to cover some bank holidays (aprox. 6 per year). This services are extra compensated.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran und gehört zu SIX, der drittgrößten Börsengruppe in Europa. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen. Senior Software Analyst & Developer Madrid, Barcelona | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8109 Treten Sie unserem Team bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft der europäischen Clearingdienste. Als Software Analyst & Developer arbeiten Sie im Herzen eines geschäftskritischen Clearing-Ökosystems, unterstützen und entwickeln komplexe Anwendungen und tragen gleichzeitig zur Entwicklung einer einheitlichen Clearing-Plattform der nächsten Generation bei, die mit Oracle, PL / SQL, Java und modernen Architekturen arbeitet. Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der Stabilität, Leistung und Entwicklung eines komplexen Finanz-Ökosystems in einem internationalen Umfeld spielen. Die Einstellung könnte entweder in Madrid oder in Barcelona sein. Was Sie tun werden
• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis des Ökosystems für Clearing-Anwendungen, einschließlich Kerngeschäftsflüssen, Datenmodellen und Systemabhängigkeiten.
• Design, Entwicklung und Wartung robuster PL/SQL-Lösungen zur Unterstützung kritischer Clearing-Prozesse, die Leistung, Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit gewährleisten.
• Analysieren, Beheben und Beheben komplexer Produktionsvorfälle als Teil des L3-Supportmodells für geschäftskritische Anwendungen.
• Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch und implementieren Sie dauerhafte Korrekturen, um ein Wiederauftreten zu verhindern und so zur Systemstabilität und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beizutragen.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Support-Aktivitäten außerhalb der Geschäftszeiten, einschließlich der Lösung von Vorfällen mit hoher Priorität, die sich auf Clearing-Operationen auswirken.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Analyste et développeur logiciel senior Madrid, Barcelone Rejoignez notre équipe et jouez un rôle clé pour façonner l'avenir des services européens de compensation. En tant qu'analyste et développeur de logiciels, vous travaillerez au cœur d'un écosystème de Clearing critique pour les affaires, soutenant et développant des applications complexes tout en contribuant au développement d'une plateforme de Clearing unifiée de nouvelle génération, travaillant avec Oracle, PL/SQL, Java et des architectures modernes. Vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la stabilité, la performance et l'évolution d'un écosystème financier complexe dans un environnement international. L'embauche pourrait être soit à Madrid, soit à Barcelone. Ce que vous ferez
• Développer une compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème des applications Clearing, y compris les flux d'affaires essentiels, les modèles de données et les dépendances du système.
• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des solutions de PL/SQL robustes pour soutenir les processus de Clearing critiques, en assurant la performance, l'évolutivité et la fiabilité.
• Analyser, dépanner et résoudre des incidents de production complexes, agissant dans le cadre du modèle de support L3 pour les applications critiques pour l'entreprise.
• Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des correctifs permanents pour prévenir les récidives, contribuant à la stabilité du système et à l'amélioration continue.
• Participer à des activités de soutien en dehors des heures d'ouverture, y compris la résolution d'incidents hautement prioritaires touchant les opérations de compensation.
• Collaborer avec les architectes et les équipes d'ingénierie pour faire évoluer les systèmes existants, contribuer aux initiatives de modernisation et s'intégrer aux nouvelles architectures (p. ex., les microservices).
• Contribuer à la documentation technique, au partage des connaissances et aux processus de transfert, en assurant la maintenance à long terme et l'autonomie de l'équipe.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, les opérations et les équipes de gestion des risques afin d'assurer le fonctionnement efficace et conforme des services de compensation.
• Contribuer à la refonte, à l'analyse et au développement de la plate-forme de Clearing de la prochaine génération, en soutenant l'intégration et la consolidation des systèmes de Clearing européens dans un écosystème unifié. Ce que vous apportez
• Forte expertise dans les bases de données Oracle et le développement avancé PL/SQL, avec une expérience éprouvée dans le traitement de données complexes et l'optimisation des performances.
• Fond solide dans l'architecture de l'application et du système, en particulier dans les environnements anciens complexes.
• La compréhension du domaine d'activité de Clearing sera un plus
• Expérience des environnements Java (architecture microservices) et Linux.
• Espagnol autochtone et niveau avancé d'anglais (C1), à la fois écrit et parlé.
• Disponibilité pour effectuer les activités de soutien prévues en dehors des heures de travail normales, au besoin. C'est une compensation supplémentaire.
• Volonté de participer à une rotation de soutien 24/7 sur appel, couvrant des semaines complètes (environ une semaine par mois) et couvrant certains jours fériés (environ 6 par an). Ces services sont rémunérés en supplément. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.
