descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Senior Labor Relations Consultant (Temporary)

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8178

Si prospera sulla soluzione di sfide complesse, la costruzione di relazioni forti, e iniziative di guida che veramente importano? Hai una lunga esperienza nella consulenza HR o nella gestione del personale? Stai cercando una nuova sfida professionale e sei interessato al settore finanziario?

Unisciti al nostro team HR in Spagna come Senior Labor Relations Consultant per coprire una posizione temporanea.

Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Fornire guida e supporto su tutti gli argomenti operativi delle risorse umane relativi al ciclo di vita dei dipendenti completo; da onboarding a offboarding e tutto il resto, agendo come consulente affidabile per la leadership e il personale sulle relazioni dei dipendenti

• Fornire consulenza legale sugli accordi di lavoro, i conflitti sul posto di lavoro e le questioni disciplinari, e rappresentare la società in procedimenti giudiziari quando necessario

• Monitora gli aggiornamenti delle leggi sul lavoro locali e le normative SIX, assicura le regolazioni tempestive delle politiche HR locali e verifica la conformità con gli ultimi standard

• Agire come uno dei punti di contatto per i rappresentanti sindacali e gestire processi di contrattazione collettiva e negoziare accordi, CBA, risolvere controversie e garantire l'adesione agli accordi dell'Unione

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni efficaci con le unioni per promuovere la comprensione reciproca e l'allineamento con gli obiettivi organizzativi

• Ispezioni e requisiti della maniglia da autorità del lavoro, sicurezza sociale, Agenzia fiscale, e altre autorità

• Leader iniziative HR, tra cui programmi di diversità e inclusione, coinvolgimento dei dipendenti e gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team HR a livello locale e globale e contribuire a diversi progetti HR

Che cosa porta

• Bachelor o Master in Diritto del Lavoro, Risorse Umane o un campo correlato

• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nella consulenza HR o nella gestione del personale, con almeno 3 anni di capacità senior

• Ampia conoscenza delle leggi, dei regolamenti e degli standard di lavoro spagnoli

• Provata esperienza di gestione delle relazioni sindacali, tra cui contrattazione collettiva e risoluzione dei conflitti

• Capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice internazionale e globale

• Forte problem solving e capacità di adattamento, negoziazione e comunicazione

• Fluency in inglese e spagnolo, qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Labor Relations Consultant (Temporary)

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8178

Do you thrive on solving complex challenges, building strong relationships, and driving initiatives that truly matter? Do you have extended experience in HR consulting or personnel management? Are you looking for a new professional challenge and are you interested in financial sector?
Join our HR team in Spain as Senior Labor Relations Consultant to cover a 1 year temporary position.

We are offering a direct contract with us, competitive remuneration (up to 70.000 € gross annual salary depending on candidate’s experience and profile) and a full package of social benefits.

We are looking forward to hear from you. Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Provide guidance and support on all HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle; from onboarding to offboarding and everything in between, acting as a trusted advisor to leadership and staff on employee relations

• Provide legal advice on employment agreements, workplace conflicts, and disciplinary matters, and represent the company in court proceedings when necessary

• Monitor updates to local labor laws and SIX regulations, ensure timely adjustments to local HR policies, and verify their compliance with the latest standards

• Act as one of the points of contact for union representatives and manage collective bargaining processes and negotiate agreements, CBA, resolve disputes, and ensure adherence to Union agreements

• Build and maintain effective relationships with Unions to promote mutual understanding and alignment with organizational goals

• Handle inspections and requirements from labor authorities, Social Security, Tax Agency, and other authorities

• Lead HR initiatives, including diversity and inclusion programs, employee engagement, and organizational change management, working closely with HR teams at both local and global levels and contribute to different HR projects

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Labor Law, Human Resources or a related field

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in HR consulting or personnel management, with at least 3 years in a senior capacity

• Extensive knowledge of Spanish labor laws, regulations, and employment standards

• Proven experience managing union relationships, including collective bargaining and conflict resolution

• Ability to navigate in an international and global matrix organization

• Strong problem-solving and adaptability, negotiation, and communication skills

• Fluency in English and Spanish, any other language is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Was Sie tun werden

• Beratung und Unterstützung bei allen operativen HR-Themen im Zusammenhang mit dem gesamten Lebenszyklus der Mitarbeiter; von Onboarding bis Offboarding und allem dazwischen, als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeiter in Bezug auf Mitarbeiterbeziehungen

• Rechtsberatung zu Arbeitsverträgen, Arbeitskonflikten und Disziplinarangelegenheiten und Vertretung des Unternehmens bei Bedarf in Gerichtsverfahren

• Überwachen Sie Aktualisierungen der lokalen Arbeitsgesetze und SIX-Vorschriften, stellen Sie rechtzeitige Anpassungen der lokalen Personalrichtlinien sicher und überprüfen Sie deren Einhaltung mit den neuesten Standards

• Als eine der Anlaufstellen für Gewerkschaftsvertreter fungieren und Tarifverhandlungen und Verhandlungsvereinbarungen, KNA verwalten, Streitigkeiten beilegen und die Einhaltung der Unionsvereinbarungen sicherstellen

• Aufbau und Pflege effektiver Beziehungen zu Gewerkschaften zur Förderung des gegenseitigen Verständnisses und der Ausrichtung auf die organisatorischen Ziele

• Handhabung von Inspektionen und Anforderungen von Arbeitsbehörden, Sozialversicherung, Steuerbehörde und anderen Behörden

• Leiten Sie HR-Initiativen, einschließlich Diversity- und Inklusionsprogrammen, Mitarbeiterengagement und organisatorischem Change Management, arbeiten Sie eng mit HR-Teams auf lokaler und globaler Ebene zusammen und tragen Sie zu verschiedenen HR-Projekten bei

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Arbeitsrecht, Personalwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung in HR-Beratung oder Personalmanagement, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in leitender Funktion

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der spanischen Arbeitsgesetze, Vorschriften und Beschäftigungsstandards

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Umgang mit gewerkschaftlichen Beziehungen, einschließlich Kollektivverhandlungen und Konfliktlösung

• Fähigkeit, in einer internationalen und globalen Matrixorganisation zu navigieren

• Starke Problemlösungs- und Anpassungsfähigkeit, Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• fließend in Englisch und Spanisch, jede andere Sprache ist ein Plus

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an.

Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

• Connaissance approfondie des lois, règlements et normes du travail espagnols

• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des relations syndicales, y compris la négociation collective et le règlement des conflits

You will design scalable cross-module solutions and drive standards, governance and best practices across the platform, ensuring a secure, compliant and future-ready setup in a regulated environment. • define and drive the CMDB and service modelling strategy (CSDM) and provide architecture oversight for CMDB health and evolution

• act as a trusted advisor by translating business requirements into effective ServiceNow solutions and clearly communicating architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• drive solution direction in close collaboration with the Platform Owner and Enterprise Architecture, ensuring alignment with governance, security and overall platform strategy

• help ensure that legacy requirements are appropriately challenged and that the target platform evolves through standardization, simplification and scalable design principles

What You Bring

• bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including substantial architecture responsibility in complex enterprise environments

• strong experience designing ServiceNow solutions in organizations with demanding compliance, audit and governance requirements

• CSA certification is mandatory

• additional certifications such as CAD, CIS ITSM or other relevant CIS certifications are strongly preferred

• strong understanding of ServiceNow implementation strategies, architectural best practices and platform governance

• certifications such as CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps are preferred

• CTA or CMA certifications are a strong advantage

• experience with AI is a strong plus

• experience with Git is preferred

• proven ability to design secure and compliant integrations, as well as enterprise-scale workflows

• experience designing CMDB/CSDM models integrated with BMC Discovery in complex enterprise environments is preferred

• experience contributing to Design Authority reviews and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and platform strategy is a strong plus

• experience in highly regulated environments is preferred

• fluent English communication skills, written and spoken

• German language skills are preferred

Éditeur de données des actions et des obligations avec français

• La connaissance du langage SQL est un plus

• expérience avec les outils JIRA et Confluence

• Études supérieures en gestion/finance (idéalement un master)

• fort intérêt et passion pour les marchés financiers

• excellentes compétences analytiques, autonomie, rigueur et esprit d'équipe

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Asset Servicing Internship

Madrid | Flexible Working Model | Reference 8236

Are you a student with excellent organizational skills and an interest in the financial industry, looking for an exciting internship in Securities Services? We are looking for a bright, dedicated team player who will like to join our Global Asset Servicing team for a minimum of a six-month internship to provide hands-on support in managing the day-to-day operations of Asset Servicing.

Our global team, located in Switzerland and Spain, is responsible for Asset Servicing in the Domestic markets. We process all issuances and corporate actions in close cooperation with issuers, involved custodians and market participants. You will be part of a specialized team in which you will gather relevant practical experience and insights into the securities value chain and the cooperation with various interfaces will enable you to build up a broad network.

What You Will Do

• manage registration/deregistration of securities in the Spanish Market

• manage income corporate events such as dividends, coupon payments, redemptions…

• support SIX issuers and their agents on their day-to-day business

• identify and implement opportunities to improve and automate our processes liaising with other Asset Servicing team members

• provide ad hoc support to the projects related to the Asset Servicing team

What You Bring

• bachelor's or master's degree related to Business administration, finance, economics, etc. Knowledge of financial markets will be also a plus, but is not mandatory

• ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent organizational skills

• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously, paired with good time management skills and with a continued motivation to learn

• strong analytical skills with an eye for details and a team member mindset

• very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English (B2 minimum) to interact with our international colleagues

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Are you passionate about finance? Do you have very good analytical skills to assess complex accounting issues under IFRS and Spanish GAAP? Do you have experience working in a multinational Group? Your tasks will consist of processing and supervising daily business activities (accounting entries, mapping of interface data, reconciliation, etc.) of the entities of the SIX Group located in Spain and France. You will contribute to monthly / quarterly / annual closing activities and reporting of said entities and work closely with different departments and locations (in particular headquarter in Switzerland) to ensure that the financial statements are prepared in accordance with IFRS, Spanish GAAP and SIX’s standards.

Does it sound interesting for you? Apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• independently process and supervise daily business and period-end closings. Prepare individual and consolidated financial statements (Cuentas Anuales), and other relevant financial and activity reports (CNMV) of the Spanish and French entities of the SIX Group.

• prepare internal reporting and support Group consolidation process. Develop and implement the accounting policies of BME and new applicable IFRS standards and/or services in line with the SIX Group accounting policies

• assess complex accounting matters under Spanish GAAP, IFRS, and other applicable legislation

• contribute to and/or lead strategic projects (e.g. restructuring, due diligence processes, PPAs, first consolidation of newly acquired companies or businesses, divestments, financial integration, impairment, etc.)

What You Bring

• university Degree in Business Administration and advanced education in Finance & Accounting (e.g. certified auditor)

• 4 years minimum experience in financial audit (Big 4 or consultancy sector preferably) or in a similar position related with accounting or financial reporting including month-end closing activities in an international Group operating in different locations

• in-depth expertise in Spanish GAAP, IFRS and consolidation. Knowledge about internal control systems and procedures will be highly valued

• good command of Excel and knowledge of SAP. Any experience with reporting tools (e.g. SAC, Power-BI) will be an advantage

• resilient, responsible, proactive, independent and honest personality interested in working on a customer-oriented team and open to work in a multi-cultural environment, having also strong analytical, time-management, communication and coordination skills

• proficiency in written and spoken English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Do you want to work in a dynamic environment at the heart of financial markets? Are you passionate about data quality, operational excellence, and collaboration? Curious about how indices such as the IBEX 35, SMI and SPI are maintained every day?

Then our Index Operations team wants to hear from you! We are an agile and international team responsible for the daily maintenance, reviews, and quality assurance of SIX’s equity and fixed income indices. By ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of indices used as benchmarks for financial products worldwide, we play a key role in supporting global financial markets. In this role, you will work closely with Product Management, IT, Index Sales, and clients in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. We are looking forward to hear from you!

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the management and maintenance of all SIX and custom equity and fixed income indices, with a primary focus on SIX Spanish indices.

• Participate in Production, Corporate Actions, and Index Review shift rotations, including the coordination of ongoing index changes.

• Determine index constituents and weightings as part of the periodic review process.

• Provide incident management support and 2nd level operational support.

• Implement index changes across relevant applications and systems.

• Ensure compliance with Working Instructions, Index Governance requirements, and the Controls Framework.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of operational quality, process stability, and efficiency, including the execution of Business Acceptance Testing (BAT).

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration or any related field. Studies related with the financial sector or Capital Markets will be a plus.

• 1st working experience in the financial sector, preferable in operational, middle-office or back-office areas.

• Ability to perform under pressure, manage priorities effectively and able to work independently with a well-organized and self-driven personality.

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

• Excellent Spanish and English communication skills; German will be an advantage.

• Strong Excel and Python skills for data analysis, automation, and operational support.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Analisi dell'indice

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8180

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente dinamico al centro dei mercati finanziari? Sei appassionato di qualità dei dati, eccellenza operativa e collaborazione? Curioso su come gli indici come SMI, SPI e IBEX 35 vengono mantenuti ogni giorno?

Allora il nostro team di Index Operations vuole sentire da voi! Siamo un team agile e internazionale responsabile della manutenzione quotidiana, delle recensioni e della garanzia di qualità degli indici azionari e fisse di SIX. Garantindo l'accuratezza, l'affidabilità e l'integrità degli indici utilizzati come benchmark per i prodotti finanziari in tutto il mondo, abbiamo un ruolo chiave nel sostenere i mercati finanziari globali. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con Product Management, IT, Index Sales e i clienti in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce.

Cosa farai

• Responsabile per la gestione e la manutenzione di tutti gli indici SIX e azionari e fissi.

• Partecipazione a turni di produzione, azioni aziendali e indice Review, incluso il coordinamento dei cambiamenti indice.

• Determinare i costituenti e le ponderazioni degli indici come parte del processo di revisione periodica.

• Fornire supporto alla gestione degli incidenti e supporto operativo di secondo livello.

• Cambiamenti dell'indice di implementazione in applicazioni e sistemi rilevanti.

• Assicurare la conformità alle istruzioni di lavoro, ai requisiti di governance dell'indice e al quadro di controllo.

• Contribuisci al continuo miglioramento della qualità operativa, della stabilità dei processi e dell'efficienza, inclusa l'esecuzione del Business Acceptance Testing (BAT).

Che cosa porta

• Capacità di eseguire sotto pressione e gestire le priorità in modo efficace.

• Ben organizzato, auto-driven, e in grado di lavorare indipendentemente.

• Forte capacità organizzative e di priorità.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione inglese; tedesco o spagnolo è un vantaggio.

• Forte competenze Excel e Python per l'analisi dei dati, l'automazione e il supporto operativo.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Indexanalyst

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8180

Möchten Sie in einem dynamischen Umfeld im Herzen der Finanzmärkte arbeiten? Sie interessieren sich für Datenqualität, operative Exzellenz und Zusammenarbeit? Neugierig, wie Indizes wie SMI, SPI und IBEX 35 jeden Tag gepflegt werden?

Dann möchte unser Index Operations Team von Ihnen hören! Wir sind ein agiles und internationales Team, das für die tägliche Pflege, Überprüfung und Qualitätssicherung der Aktien- und Anleiheindizes von SIX verantwortlich ist. Durch die Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Integrität von Indizes, die weltweit als Benchmarks für Finanzprodukte verwendet werden, spielen wir eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Unterstützung der globalen Finanzmärkte. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit Produktmanagement, IT, Index Sales und Kunden in einer kollaborativen und schnelllebigen Umgebung zusammen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Verantwortlich für die Verwaltung und Pflege aller SIX und Custom Equity und Fixed Income Indizes.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an den Verschiebungsrotationen von Produktion, Corporate Actions und Index Review, einschließlich der Koordination laufender Indexänderungen.

• Bestimmung von Indexbestandteilen und Gewichtungen als Teil des periodischen Überprüfungsprozesses.

• Bereitstellung von Incident Management Support und 2nd Level operativer Unterstützung.

• Implementieren Sie Indexänderungen in relevanten Anwendungen und Systemen.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Arbeitsanweisungen, Index Governance-Anforderungen und des Controls Framework.

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Betriebsqualität, Prozessstabilität und Effizienz, einschließlich der Durchführung von Business Acceptance Testing (BAT).

Was du mitbringst

• Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und Prioritäten effektiv zu verwalten.

• Gut organisiert, selbstgesteuert und in der Lage, unabhängig zu arbeiten.

• Starke organisatorische und Priorisierung Fähigkeiten.

• Hervorragende englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; Deutsch oder Spanisch ist von Vorteil.

• Starke Excel- und Python-Fähigkeiten für Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und Betriebsunterstützung.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste des index

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible.

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement dynamique au cœur des marchés financiers? Êtes-vous passionné par la qualité des données, l'excellence opérationnelle et la collaboration? Curieux de savoir comment des indices tels que le SMI, le SPI et l'IBEX 35 sont maintenus chaque jour?

Alors, notre équipe des Opérations Index veut vous entendre ! Nous sommes une équipe agile et internationale responsable de l'entretien quotidien, des examens et de l'assurance qualité de SIX. En assurant la précision, la fiabilité et l'intégrité des indices utilisés comme repères pour les produits financiers dans le monde entier, nous jouons un rôle clé dans le soutien des marchés financiers mondiaux. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la gestion des produits, les TI, les ventes d'indices et les clients dans un environnement collaboratif et accéléré.

Ce que vous ferez

• Responsable de la gestion et de la maintenance de tous les indices SIX, fonds propres sur mesure et à revenu fixe.

• Participer à la production, aux actions de l'organisation et à la rotation des équipes d'examen des indices, y compris la coordination des changements d'indice en cours.

• Déterminer les constituants de l'indice et les pondérations dans le cadre du processus d'examen périodique.

• Fournir un soutien à la gestion des incidents et un soutien opérationnel de deuxième niveau.

• Mettre en place des changements d'index pour les applications et les systèmes pertinents.

• Assurer la conformité avec les instructions de travail, les exigences de gouvernance de l'index et le cadre de contrôle.

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la qualité opérationnelle, de la stabilité des processus et de l'efficacité, y compris l'exécution des tests d'acceptation des entreprises.

Ce que vous apportez

• Capacité de faire face à la pression et de gérer efficacement les priorités.

• Bien organisé, autonome et capable de travailler indépendamment.

• Compétences solides en matière d'organisation et de hiérarchisation.

• Excellentes compétences de communication en anglais; l'allemand ou l'espagnol est un avantage.

• Fortes compétences Excel et Python pour l'analyse de données, l'automatisation et le soutien opérationnel.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

• Act as the single point of contact for IT GRC topics and take a coordinator and interface role including training and awareness for line management, SME, projects and GRC initiatives

What You Bring

• Several years of experience in IT Risk & Control, Audit and Operations

• Interdisciplinary knowledge of IT processes, operations and architectures

• Proven experience in IT risk identification, assessment and mitigation strategies

• Understanding and applying IT risk, audit and control methodologies

• Good organizational skills, structured way of working and the ability to identify problems and solve them systematically

• Very good written and spoken English skills. German and/or Spanish are a plus.

Spécialiste en acquisition de talents (avec l'allemand)

Varsovie: travailler à partir de chez soi jusqu'à 40% possible.

Voulez-vous jouer un rôle actif dans la constitution d'équipes à travers les pays? Rejoignez notre équipe d'acquisition de talents en tant que spécialiste de l'acquisition de talents à Varsovie, où vous gérerez l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, les talents de source, les partenaires avec les intervenants et les améliorations de processus de soutien. Faites partie d'une équipe avec la propriété au cœur!

Ce que vous ferez

• Gérer le recrutement de bout en bout dans tous les secteurs, en partenariat avec les gestionnaires d'embauche sur les besoins et les perspectives du marché.

• Sourcer, attirer et mobiliser des talents par divers canaux, coordonner et mener des entrevues pour une expérience fluide et professionnelle.

• Maintenir des données exactes sur le recrutement et contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble de l'équipe.

• Collaborer avec les pairs et les équipes des RH pour planifier les activités d'embauche et aligner les priorités de recrutement sur les besoins opérationnels.

• Appuyer les initiatives interfonctionnelles qui améliorent les pratiques d'acquisition de talents et favorisent une collaboration efficace.

Ce que vous apportez

• L'expérience éprouvée de gestion du recrutement se termine pour les rôles IT et Fintech en Suisse ou dans la région DACH, en appliquant des méthodes structurées sur tous les cycles de recrutement.

• Expérience pratique de l'approvisionnement actif, en utilisant des outils et des canaux pour créer et mobiliser de solides pipelines de talents.

• L'état d'esprit mondial avec l'expérience de travailler dans des équipes réparties entre les pays, les cultures et les milieux de collaboration.

• Une bonne communication et des compétences des intervenants associées à la capacité de gérer efficacement plusieurs processus d'embauche.

• L'anglais et l'allemand doivent soutenir la communication dans un environnement international. Espagnol désiré.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez l'Allemand Lopez Arranz au +34 91 709 5771 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Referencia 8032

Are you interested in automating a modern and secure environment with strong focus on process automation and service integration? We invest in bright minds, in their ideas, knowledge and development. • Fluent in English.

• Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration.

Senior QA Testing Lead Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8056 We are looking for an experienced and motivated Testing Lead in Madrid to join our Clearing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity for a QA professional who thrives in complex environments and wants to play a key role in shaping quality across business-critical initiatives. In this role, you will define, implement, and lead testing strategies and quality standards for projects and change requests, helping to deliver high-quality, compliant software in a collaborative and international setting. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering seamless teamwork and aligning testing activities with project milestones and release plans. What You Bring
• A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in test management, including responsibility for medium to large or complex projects, with end-to-end ownership of test strategy, execution oversight, defect management, and quality assurance governance.
• A proven track record of successfully leading test management activities across multiple releases or projects and delivering strong quality outcomes in complex environments.
• Solid understanding of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies, with the flexibility to adapt testing approaches to different delivery models.
• Experience in coordinating and leading a team of more than six testers, providing guidance, structure, and support to achieve shared quality goals.
• Strong proficiency in JIRA for test management, change request tracking, and transparent documentation of defects, resolutions, and project progress.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Testing Manager

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8056

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Testing Lead in Madrid to join our Clearing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity for a QA professional who thrives in complex environments and wants to play a key role in shaping quality across business-critical initiatives. In this role, you will define, implement, and lead testing strategies and quality standards for projects and change requests, helping to deliver high-quality, compliant software in a collaborative and international setting. Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in Spanish is highly preferred.

We are looking forward to meet you. Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and drive a comprehensive test strategy covering functional, non-functional, and regression testing to support successful project delivery and high-quality outcomes.

• Lead QA activities for change requests related to continuous enhancements and maintenance within Clearing applications, ensuring quality standards are met and releases are delivered with confidence throughout the year.

• Establish and oversee an effective defect management process in JIRA, working closely with development and business teams to ensure timely resolution and continuous quality improvement.

• Facilitate regular test management meetings to review progress, resolve concerns, and keep stakeholders aligned on delivery goals and change priorities.

• Identify risks early and proactively escalate critical issues to project management to support informed decisions and timely resolution.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering seamless teamwork and aligning testing activities with project milestones and release plans.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in test management, including responsibility for medium to large or complex projects, with end-to-end ownership of test strategy, execution oversight, defect management, and quality assurance governance.

• A proven track record of successfully leading test management activities across multiple releases or projects and delivering strong quality outcomes in complex environments.

• Solid understanding of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies, with the flexibility to adapt testing approaches to different delivery models.

• Experience in coordinating and leading a team of more than six testers, providing guidance, structure, and support to achieve shared quality goals.

• Strong proficiency in JIRA for test management, change request tracking, and transparent documentation of defects, resolutions, and project progress.

• Fluency in both verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Singapore | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7751

We are looking for a skilled and reliability-driven Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to strengthen our engineering team. •

• Analyze logs, metrics, and system behavior to proactively detect anomalies, automate operational processes using Ansible and scripting.

• Effective communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Specialista della conformità dei dati

London | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8086

Sei pronto a fare un impatto nel mondo frenetico dei dati finanziari? Unisciti al nostro team di Global Risk, Regulatory & Rights Management di SIX e aiuta a plasmare il nostro ambizioso viaggio di crescita.

In questo ruolo dinamico e versatile, si prende possesso di Data Compliance, consigliando sui requisiti SIX e Data Fornitore attraverso progetti e operazioni. Analizzi l'utilizzo dei dati dei clienti, i flussi di dati e le configurazioni delle soluzioni per garantire strutture chiare e conformi e tradurre intuizioni nella documentazione pratica e facile da usare. Contribuisci anche alle attività di Customer Due Diligence e supporta le Audit dei fornitori di dati.

In qualità di esperto di fiducia, si lavora a stretto contatto sia con i team che con quelli interni, giocando un ruolo chiave nella nostra catena del valore di consegna dei dati.

Stiamo cercando qualcuno guidato, organizzato e motivato, che gode di lavorare indipendentemente, prende la proprietà, ed è desideroso di crescere, avere successo e dare un contributo significativo. La competenza in MS Excel, SQL e un approccio pragmatico e pratico vi permetterà di fornire risultati pratici e di alta qualità.

Cosa farai

• Analizzare i pacchetti di dati dei fornitori di dati e gli accordi di licenza sui diritti di proprietà intellettuale

• Sostenere la creazione di documentazione che dimostri il coinvolgimento dei partner nelle consegne SIX a clienti finali.

• Notifica commerciale del cliente, suggerisci modifiche per una chiara comprensione del cliente.

• Assumere la responsabilità e guidare Vendite, Gestione licenze di dati e il team di operazioni dei clienti sui termini e condizioni del fornitore di dati

Cosa farai

• Contribuisci a migliorare continuamente i servizi di Cyber Security Resilience relativi a: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB), Vulnerability Management (VM)

• Definire standard operativi, processi e miglioramenti KPI per i controlli di resilienza.

• Guidare l'adozione di best practice di sicurezza informatica e requisiti normativi in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Analizzare le tendenze della vulnerabilità, i livelli di esposizione e l'efficacia della correzione in tutto l'ambiente.

• Impegnatevi direttamente con i team tecnologici per dare priorità e guidare le attività di bonifica.

• Sviluppare e mantenere metodologie di gestione delle vulnerabilità basate sui rischi.

• Valutare la conformità della linea di base tra infrastrutture e ambienti applicativi.

• Collabora con i team di ingegneria per migliorare la postura della conformità della configurazione generale.

• Interpretare i requisiti normativi e tradurli in controlli tecnici e operativi.

• Sostenere le valutazioni dei rischi e controllare le recensioni sull'efficacia.

Che cosa porta

• 5+ anni di esperienza in Cyber Security, sicurezza delle infrastrutture o ingegneria della sicurezza.

• Forte esperienza pratica in: Gestione della vulnerabilità, Baseline di configurazione sicura (CIS Benchmarks), Monitoraggio dell'integrità file

Business Analyst - Market Data & Entitlements (with French) Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7630 Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of market data? As part of a team of specialists you will help build and operate reliable market data and entitlement flows for French Products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). You will analyze and specify requirements for pricing and reference content sourced from MDF Stream/MDF Select, IPS and some direct contributors. You will ensure this content is normalized, high quality, and distributed to all French Products and clients with the correct licensing and access controls. Working closely with product, engineering, operations, and QA, you’ll translate MDF and IPS specifications and market rules into clear, testable documentation that enables accurate data delivery. You will occupy a central position between two data models (Global and FR) that allow French products to fully benefit from the rich market data of the global model. What You Will Do
• Gather and document the functional and non-functional requirements of real-time and end-of-day price data feeds, as well as the repositories provided by MDF and IPS, to cover all the needs of French products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). Define the standardization, enrichment, and validation rules.
• Design and maintain entitlement models and content distribution rules for French products, ensuring compliance with provider licensing and contractual constraints.
• Support onboarding and certification of new/changed feeds from MDF and IPS. Coordinate test scenarios, ensure their validation and non-regression across the entire system.
• Investigate incidents and drive corrective actions with providers and internal teams.
• Contribute to market data documentation & standards and process improvements across all delivery channels for French Products (MDF, IPS, Finalim, PGD, Europerf, and TDI for entitlement). What You Bring
• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in market data or financial information.
• Strong understanding of market data concepts, normalization, and data quality controls.
• Experience with market data providers and feeds. Knowledge of access rights frameworks and models, data distribution flows, and licensing obligations.
• Ability to translate business rules into technical specifications and test cases; solid documentation skills.
• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; familiarity with APIs and file-based delivery; comfortable collaborating with product, engineering, QA, and operations.
• Exposure to agile methods (e.g., Jira/Azure DevOps) and quality assurance practices (UAT, regression).
• Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment. DevOps Engineer - Containerization & Cloud

Barcelona, Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7624

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational excellence drive everything we do? Are you eager to learn, bring new ideas, and tackle challenges in a modern DevOps setup? We are looking for an Application DevOps Engineer focused on automated cloud deployments and container platforms. In this role, you will support development teams by designing and operating Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, automating infrastructure and deployment processes, providing standardized CI/CD pipelines, and configuring shared operational services. Working with tools like Kubernetes, OpenShift, Argo CD, GitLab, Ansible, and container registries, you will help build scalable release processes, improve deployment reliability, and ensure consistent ado

ption of DevOps and GitOps best practices.

What You Will Do

• Build and maintain automated deployment workflows for containerized applications in Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Manage GitOps processes using Argo CD and GitLab CI/CD, including rollout strategies and configuration management.

• Implement Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Helm, Terraform/Ansible) for consistent and auditable changes.

• Work with application and infrastructure teams to onboard and standardize services on Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks for reliable operations.

• Contribute to cluster upgrades, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

• Develop and support CI/CD pipelines, reusable automation templates, and onboarding materials.

• Assist teams with pipeline integration, secrets management, and observability.

• Document standards and promote DevOps best practices.

What You Will Bring

• Experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, especially with Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Strong skills in Python, shell scripting, GitLab CI/CD, and Argo CD.

• Knowledge of Infrastructure‑as‑Code, preferably with Ansible and Helm.

• Solid understanding of Linux, networking, and containerization concepts.

• Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk).

• Strong troubleshooting skills in microservices environments.

• Clear communication skills with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

• Fluency in English; German or Spanish is a plus.

• provide guidance and support to managers and employees based in Switzerland on HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle (recruitment, assessment, development, retention, transfer, etc.)

• ensure proper execution of HR processes to mitigate risk, while actively identifying workflow inefficiencies and driving continuous improvement

• collaborate with HRBP’s, HR Centers of Expertise and the HR Service Center to deliver cohesive and aligned HR solutions that meet business needs

• manage a variety of administrative and coordination tasks to support seamless HR operations

• coordinate and implement the annual compensation review process within the assigned area of responsibility

• work in partnership with both team members in Switzerland and global HR teams and departments, actively contributing to the implementation of Swiss and global HR projects and initiatives

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• at least 5 years of professional experience in HR consulting or personnel management, including a minimum of 2 years working in an international HR environment, supporting European-based staff, preferably in Switzerland

• strong track record in consulting, with demonstrated problem-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal communication skills

• proven ability to function within an international matrix structure and manage diverse cultural dynamics

• proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), particularly SAP SuccessFactors

• excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a strong advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Supporto per il Team Studente di Lavoro - Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance (40-60%) Zurigo | 40-60% | Riferimento 8105 Stai cercando un'opportunità per acquisire esperienza pratica accanto ai tuoi studi per sfidarti in un ambiente internazionale? Poi unisciti al nostro team Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance di SIX, un fornitore leader di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario che serve il centro finanziario svizzero. Come studente di lavoro, acquisirai preziose informazioni sul lavoro quotidiano di Enterprise Architecture e IT Governance, supportando iniziative di comunicazione, attività di coordinamento, documentazione e processi operativi. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica e l'esposizione ad una vasta gamma di argomenti all'incrocio tra business e IT. Forniamo un ambiente di lavoro di supporto con opportunità di crescita personale e professionale, insieme con la possibilità di un membro nella Comunità SIX NextGen. Cosa farai
• Contribuire alle iniziative di comunicazione relative all'architettura aziendale e preparare materiali come presentazioni, mappe degli stakeholder e framework di comunicazione
• Supporta i processi operativi in Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) tra cui la manutenzione e la struttura dei dati e della documentazione
• Preparare le presentazioni strutturando i dati e traducendolo in visualizzazioni e sintesi di gestione
• Organizza eventi interni (ad esempio Giornata dell'Architettura e workshop)
• Coordinare le riunioni, compresa la programmazione e l'allineamento dei partecipanti Che cosa porta
• Attualmente perseguire una laurea o Master in Informatica aziendale, Business Administration, comunicazioni, o un campo correlato
• Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione con un modo strutturato di lavorare
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire più attività contemporaneamente
• Proficienza in Microsoft Office, in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel
• Fluente in inglese e tedesco; lo spagnolo è un vantaggio Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Janine Reichling al numero +41 58 399 42 99 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Working Student Team Support - Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance (40-60%)

Zurich | 40-60% | Reference 8105

Are you looking for an opportunity to gain practical experience alongside your studies to challenge yourself in an international environment? Then join our Enterprise Architecture & IT Governance team at SIX, a leading financial market infrastructure provider serving the Swiss financial center.

As a Working Student, you will gain valuable insights into the day-to-day work of Enterprise Architecture and IT Governance while supporting communication initiatives, coordination activities, documentation, and operational processes. This role offers hands-on experience and exposure to a wide range of topics at the intersection of business and IT. We provide a supportive working environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth, along with the option for a Membership in the SIX NextGen Community.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to communication initiatives related to Enterprise Architecture and prepare materials such as presentations, stakeholder maps, and communication frameworks

• Support operational processes in Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) including the maintenance and structure of data and documentation

• Prepare presentations by structuring data and translating it into visualizations and management summaries

• Organize internal events (e.g. Architecture Day and workshops)

• Coordinate meetings, including scheduling and participant alignment

What You Bring

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field

• Strong organizational and communication skills with a structured way of working

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel

• Fluent in English and German; Spanish is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Full-Stack Developer

Warsaw | working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7935

descriptionByLocale.it: SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Specialista delle operazioni del cliente Paris | wotking from home fino al 40% | Riferimento 8145 Come contributore chiave alle nostre operazioni di vendita, gestirai un territorio cliente definito in stretta collaborazione con un rappresentante delle vendite. Avrete anche la proprietà di tutte le attività amministrative e di supporto relative alle vendite e l'implementazione di sistemi informativi finanziari per i nostri clienti. Cosa farai • Territory Management: supervisionare un territorio di vendita dei clienti in collaborazione con Sales and Account Manager, concentrandosi sui prodotti dei servizi finanziari per i clienti francesi • Servizio Clienti: Servire come punto di contatto primario per le richieste dei clienti relative a prodotti, funzionalità, dati, prezzi, autorizzazioni di cambio e risoluzione dei problemi • Amministrazione del contratto: Progetto, processo e gestione dei contratti dei clienti all'interno del sistema informativo finanziario del cliente • Billing & Financial Oversight: avviare i processi di fatturazione e monitorare le procedure e le procedure d'esecuzione per garantire la precisione finanziaria • Coordinamento del progetto: Gestire i diritti dei prodotti e dei dati, pianificare, coordinare e monitorare i progetti relativi al cliente e alle vendite dall'avvio al completamento Che cosa porta • Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente in un ambiente centrale o back-office • Forte attitudine numerica e attenzione ai dettagli • Concentrati sul cliente con un approccio proattivo e ben organizzato • Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un ambiente dinamico • Esperienza linguistica: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta in francese e inglese Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. Cosa offriamo Modelli di lavoro flessibili Ci fidiamo dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo un ambiente di lavoro ben bilanciato, produttivo e favorisce il successo. Sviluppo personale Potrai beneficiare di una cultura di apprendimento continuo e feedback. La vostra crescita personale è sostenuta attraverso un'ampia offerta di apprendimento.
descriptionByLocale.en: SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Customer Operations Specialist Paris | wotking from home up to 40% | Reference 8145 As a key contributor to our sales operations, you will manage a defined customer territory in close collaboration with a Sales Representative. You will also take ownership of all administrative and support activities related to sales and the implementation of financial information systems for our clients. What You Will Do • Territory Management: Oversee a customer sales territory in partnership with Sales and Account Managers, focusing on financial services products for French customers • Client Service: Serve as a primary point of contact for customer inquiries related to products, functionalities, data, pricing, exchange permissions, and issue resolution • Contract Administration: Draft, process, and manage customer contracts within the financial customer information system • Billing & Financial Oversight: Initiate invoicing processes and monitor dunning procedures and accruals to ensure financial accuracy • Project Coordination: Manage product and data entitlements, and plan, coordinate, and track customer and sales-related projects from initiation to completion What You Bring • At least 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in a middle or back-office environment • Strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail • Customer-focused with a proactive and well-organized approach • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment • Language Proficiency: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success. Personal Development You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen. Customer Operations Spezialist Paris | Wotking von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8145 Als wichtiger Beitrag zu unseren Vertriebsaktivitäten verwalten Sie ein definiertes Kundengebiet in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem Vertriebsmitarbeiter. Sie übernehmen auch die Verantwortung für alle administrativen und unterstützenden Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit dem Verkauf und der Implementierung von Finanzinformationssystemen für unsere Kunden. Was Sie tun werden • Territory Management: Überwachen Sie ein Kundenverkaufsgebiet in Partnerschaft mit Sales und Account Managern, wobei Sie sich auf Finanzdienstleistungsprodukte für französische Kunden konzentrieren • Kundenservice: Als primärer Ansprechpartner für Kundenanfragen in Bezug auf Produkte, Funktionen, Daten, Preise, Austauschberechtigungen und Problemlösung dienen • Vertragsverwaltung: Entwurf, Verarbeitung und Verwaltung von Kundenverträgen innerhalb des Finanzkundeninformationssystems • Billing & Financial Oversight: Initiieren Sie Rechnungsstellungsprozesse und überwachen Sie Mahnverfahren und Rückstellungen, um finanzielle Genauigkeit zu gewährleisten • Projektkoordination: Verwalten Sie Produkt- und Datenberechtigungen und planen, koordinieren und verfolgen Sie kunden- und vertriebsbezogene Projekte von der Einleitung bis zum Abschluss Was du mitbringst • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle, vorzugsweise in einer mittleren oder Back-Office-Umgebung • Starke numerische Eignung und Liebe zum Detail • Kundenorientiert mit einem proaktiven und gut organisierten Ansatz • Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten • Sprachkenntnisse: Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Französisch und Englisch Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa an . Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund. Was wir anbieten Flexible Arbeitsmodelle Wir vertrauen unseren Mitarbeitern und bieten ein ausgewogenes, produktives und erfolgsförderndes Arbeitsumfeld. Persönliche Entwicklung Sie profitieren von einer Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens und Feedbacks. Ihr persönliches Wachstum wird durch ein umfangreiches Lernangebot unterstützt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste des opérations client

Paris: le wotking de la maison jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8145

En tant que contributeur clé de nos opérations de vente, vous gérerez un territoire client défini en étroite collaboration avec un représentant commercial. Vous serez également propriétaire de toutes les activités administratives et de soutien liées aux ventes et à la mise en place de systèmes d'information financière pour nos clients.

Ce que vous ferez

• Territory Management: Surveiller un territoire de vente de clients en partenariat avec Sales and Account Managers, en mettant l'accent sur les produits de services financiers pour les clients français

• Service à la clientèle : servir de point de contact principal pour les demandes de renseignements des clients concernant les produits, les fonctionnalités, les données, les prix, les autorisations d'échange et la résolution des problèmes

• Administration des contrats : Ébauche, traitement et gestion des contrats clients dans le système d'information sur les clients financiers

• Facturation et surveillance financière : Entreprendre des processus de facturation et surveiller les procédures de facturation et les comptes d'exercice afin d'assurer l'exactitude financière

• Coordination du projet : Gérer les droits à l'égard des produits et des données et planifier, coordonner et suivre les projets liés aux clients et aux ventes de l'initiation à l'achèvement

Ce que vous apportez

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire, de préférence dans un environnement intermédiaire ou back-office

• Forte aptitude numérique et attention au détail

• Une approche proactive et bien organisée axée sur le client

• Capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et en collaboration dans un environnement dynamique

• Compétence linguistique : Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa à .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Ce que nous offrons

Modèles de travail flexibles

Nous faisons confiance à nos employés et offrons un milieu de travail équilibré, productif et propice au succès.

Développement personnel

Vous bénéficierez d'une culture d'apprentissage continu et de rétroaction. Votre croissance personnelle est soutenue par une vaste offre d'apprentissage.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Palazzo BME Eventi Stage (Parcheggio del pomeriggio) Madrid | Modello di lavoro flessibile | Riferimento 8084 Stai studiando e hai competenze nel campo della gestione degli eventi, della comunicazione e delle relazioni pubbliche? Sei interessato al settore Comunicazione e Marketing e alla ricerca di un interessante stage per saperne di più sul settore finanziario? Se la vostra risposta è sì, il nostro team Eventi e Conferenze, responsabile di eventi e visite guidate al Palacio de la Bolsa, vi incontrerà. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona luminosa e dedicata che si diverte a lavorare in una squadra e vuole fare uno stage pomeridiano a BME, dove fornire assistenza pratica nella zona Eventi e Conferenze. La funzione si baserà al Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese. Cosa farai
• effettuare le visite guidate, supervisionare la casella di posta e rispondere alle richieste di visite guidate, amministrare e gestire tutte le richieste in arrivo (mail / telefono)
• collaborazione nello sviluppo dei materiali e dei discorsi per le visite guidate, acquisendo conoscenze e storia legate al mercato azionario e ai suoi dintorni (Stock Exchange Palace)
• sostenere i responsabili degli eventi in tutti gli aspetti della gestione degli eventi (pianificazione, preparazione, esecuzione, materiale evento, gestione degli inviti e registrazione, ecc.)
• fornire supporto ad hoc al team eventi nel loro lavoro quotidiano
• supporto on-Site agli eventi Che cosa porta
• studi in Marketing, Comunicazione, Turismo, Amministrazione Bussines o Organizzazione Evento e disponibilità per i pomeriggi (da 14 a 19h Lunedì a Venerdì)
• capacità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e globale con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di comunicazione
• forti capacità organizzative e flessibilità personale
• disponibilità a collaborare e lavorare autonomamente abbinato a buone capacità di gestione del tempo
• ottimo livello di inglese e spagnolo parlato e scritto (minimo B2)
• esperienza nell'hosting degli eventi virtuali è un vantaggio Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

BME Events Internship (Afternoon Schedule)

Madrid | Flexible Working Model | Reference 8084

Are you passionate about events and eager to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic environment. Are you interested in the Financial Industry sector and looking for an interesting internship?

If your answer is yes, our team responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you.

We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do a afternoon internship at BME, here you will provide hands-on assistance in Events and Hospitality. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1).

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Handling and managing incoming requests (mail/telephone)

• Managing incoming enquiries and preparing proposals

• Updating event details in our systems

• Supporting security-related processes such as Guest list coordination, Certificate requests, Setup coordination, documentation and monthly planning

• Supplier coordination

• Assisting with event setup activities (especially afternoon setups)

• Providing hands-on on-site support during events

• Provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work

What You Bring

• You are studying Events management, Marketing, Communication or specific training in Event Organization and you have availability for the afternoons (from 14 to 19h Monday to Friday)

• Ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills

• Strong organizational skills and personal flexibility

• Willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills

• Very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Analyst & Developer

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8109

Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of European Clearing services. As a Software Analyst & Developer, you will work at the heart of a business-critical Clearing ecosystem, supporting and evolving complex applications while contributing to the development of a next-generation, unified Clearing platform, working with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java, and modern architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and evolution of a complex financial ecosystem in an international environment. The hiring could be either in Madrid or in Barcelona.

What You Will Do

• Develop a deep understanding of the Clearing applications ecosystem, including core business flows, data models, and system dependencies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust PL/SQL solutions to support critical Clearing processes, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, acting as part of the L3 support model for business-critical applications.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence, contributing to system stability and continuous improvement.

• Participate in support activities outside business hours, including resolution of high-priority incidents affecting Clearing operations.

• Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to evolve legacy systems, contributing to modernization initiatives and integration with new architectures (e.g., microservices).

• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and handover processes, ensuring long-term maintainability and team autonomy.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, operations, and risk teams to ensure efficient and compliant operation of Clearing services.

• Contribute to the re-architecture, analysis and development of the next-generation Clearing platform, supporting the integration and consolidation of European Clearing systems into a unified ecosystem.

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in Oracle databases and advanced PL/SQL development, with proven experience in complex data processing and performance optimization.

• Solid background in application and system architecture, especially in complex legacy environments.

• Understanding of the Clearing business domain will be a plus

• Experience with Java (microservices architecture) and Linux environments.

• Native Spanish and advanced level of English (C1), both written and spoken.

• Availability to perform planned support activities outside standard working hours, when required. This is extra compensated.

• Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation, covering full weeks (approximately one week per month) and to cover some bank holidays (aprox. 6 per year). This services are extra compensated.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Forte expertise dans les bases de données Oracle et le développement avancé PL/SQL, avec une expérience éprouvée dans le traitement de données complexes et l'optimisation des performances.

descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Analyst & Developer

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8109

Join our team and play a key role in shaping the future of European Clearing services. As a Software Analyst & Developer, you will work at the heart of a business-critical Clearing ecosystem, supporting and evolving complex applications while contributing to the development of a next-generation, unified Clearing platform, working with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java, and modern architectures. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, performance, and evolution of a complex financial ecosystem in an international environment. The hiring could be either in Madrid or in Barcelona.

What You Will Do

• Develop a deep understanding of the Clearing applications ecosystem, including core business flows, data models, and system dependencies.

• Design, develop, and maintain robust PL/SQL solutions to support critical Clearing processes, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, acting as part of the L3 support model for business-critical applications.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence, contributing to system stability and continuous improvement.

• Participate in support activities outside business hours, including resolution of high-priority incidents affecting Clearing operations.

• Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to evolve legacy systems, contributing to modernization initiatives and integration with new architectures (e.g., microservices).

• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and handover processes, ensuring long-term maintainability and team autonomy.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, operations, and risk teams to ensure efficient and compliant operation of Clearing services.

• Contribute to the re-architecture, analysis and development of the next-generation Clearing platform, supporting the integration and consolidation of European Clearing systems into a unified ecosystem.

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in Oracle databases and advanced PL/SQL development, with proven experience in complex data processing and performance optimization.

• Solid background in application and system architecture, especially in complex legacy environments.

• Understanding of the Clearing business domain will be a plus

• Experience with Java (microservices architecture) and Linux environments.

• Native Spanish and advanced level of English (C1), both written and spoken.

• Availability to perform planned support activities outside standard working hours, when required. This is extra compensated.

• Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation, covering full weeks (approximately one week per month) and to cover some bank holidays (aprox. 6 per year). This services are extra compensated.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Beitrag zur Neuarchitektur, Analyse und Entwicklung der Clearing-Plattform der nächsten Generation, um die Integration und Konsolidierung europäischer Clearing-Systeme in ein einheitliches Ökosystem zu unterstützen. Was du mitbringst
• Starke Expertise in Oracle-Datenbanken und fortschrittliche PL/SQL-Entwicklung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der komplexen Datenverarbeitung und Leistungsoptimierung.

• Erfahrung mit Java (Mikroservice-Architektur) und Linux-Umgebungen.
• Muttersprachliches Spanisch und fortgeschrittenes Englisch (C1), sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

• Bereitschaft, an einer 24/7-On-Call-Support-Rotation teilzunehmen, die ganze Wochen (ca. eine Woche pro Monat) und einige Feiertage (ca. 6 pro Jahr) abdeckt. Diese Dienste werden extra kompensiert. • Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch und implementieren Sie dauerhafte Korrekturen, um ein Wiederauftreten zu verhindern und so zur Systemstabilität und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beizutragen.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Support-Aktivitäten außerhalb der Geschäftszeiten, einschließlich der Lösung von Vorfällen mit hoher Priorität, die sich auf Clearing-Operationen auswirken.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Geschäftsbetrieben und Risikoteams, um einen effizienten und konformen Betrieb der Clearingdienste sicherzustellen.
• Beitrag zur Neuarchitektur, Analyse und Entwicklung der Clearing-Plattform der nächsten Generation, um die Integration und Konsolidierung europäischer Clearing-Systeme in ein einheitliches Ökosystem zu unterstützen. Was du mitbringst
• Starke Expertise in Oracle-Datenbanken und fortschrittliche PL/SQL-Entwicklung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der komplexen Datenverarbeitung und Leistungsoptimierung.
• Solider Hintergrund in der Anwendungs- und Systemarchitektur, insbesondere in komplexen Legacy-Umgebungen.
• Das Verständnis des Clearing-Geschäftsbereichs wird ein Plus sein
• Erfahrung mit Java (Mikroservice-Architektur) und Linux-Umgebungen.
• Muttersprachliches Spanisch und fortgeschrittenes Englisch (C1), sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.
• Verfügbarkeit für geplante Unterstützungsaktivitäten außerhalb der üblichen Arbeitszeiten, falls erforderlich. Dies wird extra kompensiert.
