Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Analyste et développeur logiciel senior Madrid, Barcelone Rejoignez notre équipe et jouez un rôle clé pour façonner l'avenir des services européens de compensation. En tant qu'analyste et développeur de logiciels, vous travaillerez au cœur d'un écosystème de Clearing critique pour les affaires, soutenant et développant des applications complexes tout en contribuant au développement d'une plateforme de Clearing unifiée de nouvelle génération, travaillant avec Oracle, PL/SQL, Java et des architectures modernes. Vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la stabilité, la performance et l'évolution d'un écosystème financier complexe dans un environnement international. L'embauche pourrait être soit à Madrid, soit à Barcelone. Ce que vous ferez
• Développer une compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème des applications Clearing, y compris les flux d'affaires essentiels, les modèles de données et les dépendances du système.
• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des solutions de PL/SQL robustes pour soutenir les processus de Clearing critiques, en assurant la performance, l'évolutivité et la fiabilité.
• Analyser, dépanner et résoudre des incidents de production complexes, agissant dans le cadre du modèle de support L3 pour les applications critiques pour l'entreprise.
• Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des correctifs permanents pour prévenir les récidives, contribuant à la stabilité du système et à l'amélioration continue.
• Participer à des activités de soutien en dehors des heures d'ouverture, y compris la résolution d'incidents hautement prioritaires touchant les opérations de compensation.
• Collaborer avec les architectes et les équipes d'ingénierie pour faire évoluer les systèmes existants, contribuer aux initiatives de modernisation et s'intégrer aux nouvelles architectures (p. ex., les microservices).
• Contribuer à la documentation technique, au partage des connaissances et aux processus de transfert, en assurant la maintenance à long terme et l'autonomie de l'équipe.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, les opérations et les équipes de gestion des risques afin d'assurer le fonctionnement efficace et conforme des services de compensation.
• Contribuer à la refonte, à l'analyse et au développement de la plate-forme de Clearing de la prochaine génération, en soutenant l'intégration et la consolidation des systèmes de Clearing européens dans un écosystème unifié. Ce que vous apportez
• Forte expertise dans les bases de données Oracle et le développement avancé PL/SQL, avec une expérience éprouvée dans le traitement de données complexes et l'optimisation des performances.
• Fond solide dans l'architecture de l'application et du système, en particulier dans les environnements anciens complexes.
• La compréhension du domaine d'activité de Clearing sera un plus
• Expérience des environnements Java (architecture microservices) et Linux.
• Espagnol autochtone et niveau avancé d'anglais (C1), à la fois écrit et parlé.
• Disponibilité pour effectuer les activités de soutien prévues en dehors des heures de travail normales, au besoin. C'est une compensation supplémentaire.
• Volonté de participer à une rotation de soutien 24/7 sur appel, couvrant des semaines complètes (environ une semaine par mois) et couvrant certains jours fériés (environ 6 par an). Ces services sont rémunérés en supplément. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

• Solid understanding of object-oriented design, event-driven architectures, and messaging patterns.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Data Analyst con Francese

Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 8118

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente altamente dinamico? Sei appassionato di mercati finanziari, dati di riferimento e qualità dei dati? Allora il nostro Fixed Income & Shares Data Management Team vuole sentire da voi!

Siamo un team agile e altamente motivato responsabile della gestione e del mantenimento di dati di riferimento finanziari di alta qualità su più sistemi. Il nostro obiettivo è garantire l'accuratezza dei dati, la conformità normativa e l'eccellenza operativa per i nostri clienti interni ed esterni. In questa posizione, lavorerai a stretto contatto con le operazioni, la gestione dei dati, l'IT e i team di clienti.

Stiamo attualmente cercando 2 analisti per unirsi al nostro team a Varsavia.

AI Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655

Join us in shaping the future of financial information. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade AI solutions. If you are passionate about agentic AI, enjoy solving hard engineering problems, and want to see your work used daily by real users in a critical products, this is a unique opportunity to have a tangible impact from day one.

What You Will Do

• Architect Multi-Agent Systems: Design, build, and orchestrate complex agentic workflows using LangGraph and LangChain to handle sophisticated financial queries and agents.

• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.

• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors.

• Implement Advanced RAG: Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems to ground model responses in proprietary data.

• Establish Evaluation Pipelines: Create rigorous testing frameworks and metrics to evaluate agent performance, reliability, and accuracy in a production environment.

What You Bring

• Core AI Engineering Stack: Deep expertise in Python and the modern AI stack, including LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, and Hugging Face Transformers. Strong ability to debug and optimize multi-agent workflows, with a focus on asynchronous execution, state management, and concurrency.

• API & Data Proficiency: Experience designing and integrating with complex REST/GraphQL endpoints and handling structured data formats (JSON/XML) for tool calling.

• Cloud & DevOps Mindset: Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) for deploying production-grade AI applications.

• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in software Engineering including significant experience in as a Gen AI Application Developer. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 .

SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Risponder incidente

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8166

Il Security Operations Center (SOC) è una funzione critica della linea di difesa 1 a SIX, responsabile per rilevare, indagare e rispondere alle minacce informatiche attraverso gli ambienti endpoint, identità, rete, cloud e e e e-mail. Stiamo cercando un professionista di sicurezza pratico con esperienza in risposta agli incidenti, la caccia alle minacce e il monitoraggio della sicurezza. In questo ruolo, si indagano avvisi complessi, sviluppare e sintonizzare casi di utilizzo, sostenere gli sforzi di contenimento e di bonifica, migliorare l'automazione e playbook, e identificare proattivamente le minacce per rafforzare la postura di sicurezza generale di SIX.

Cosa farai

• Sviluppare, sintonizzare e mantenere i rilevamento delle minacce e i casi di utilizzo di SIEM in ambienti endpoint, rete, identità, cloud, mail e M365.

• Investigate complessi incidenti di sicurezza, analisi delle minacce di piombo e coordinare le attività di contenimento e di bonifica.

• Progettare e migliorare il contenuto di rilevamento, l'automazione SOC, i flussi di lavoro SOAR e i playbook di risposta incidente.

• Condurre la caccia alla minaccia proattiva utilizzando l'intelligenza delle minacce e il framework MITRE ATT&CK.

• Identificare le lacune di rilevamento e migliorare continuamente le capacità SOC e la postura di sicurezza.

• Mentor junior analisti e contribuire a miglioramenti del processo SOC e condivisione della conoscenza.

Che cosa porta

• 5+ anni di esperienza nelle operazioni SOC, ingegneria di rilevamento, caccia alle minacce e risposta agli incidenti.

• Esperienza pratica con piattaforme SIEM, EDR e SOAR (preferibilmente Sentinel, Elastico, Difensore per Endpoint e Cortex XSOAR).

• Sfondo forte nello sviluppo delle regole di rilevamento, nelle indagini di sicurezza e nella caccia alle minacce attraverso più fonti di telemetria.

• Esperienza con scripting, automazione, API e strumenti come Python, GitLab, Azure DevOps e pratiche CI/CD.

• Conoscenza delle lingue e dei framework di query di sicurezza, tra cui MITRE ATT&CK.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di comunicazione, di collaborazione e di mentoring.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Tedesco Lopez Arranz al +34 91 709 5771 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Incident Responder

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8166

The Security Operations Center (SOC) is a critical Line of Defense 1 function at SIX, responsible for detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and email environments. We are looking for a hands-on security professional with experience in incident response, threat hunting, and security monitoring. In this role, you will investigate complex alerts, develop and tune detection use cases, support containment and remediation efforts, improve automation and playbooks, and proactively identify threats to strengthen SIX's overall security posture.

What You Will Do

• Develop, tune, and maintain threat detections and SIEM use cases across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, mail, and M365 environments.

• Investigate complex security incidents, lead threat analysis, and coordinate containment and remediation activities.

• Design and improve detection content, SOC automation, SOAR workflows, and incident response playbooks.

• Conduct proactive threat hunting using threat intelligence and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Identify detection gaps and continuously enhance SOC capabilities and security posture.

• Mentor junior analysts and contribute to SOC process improvements and knowledge sharing.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in SOC operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, and incident response.

• Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, and SOAR platforms (preferably Sentinel, Elastic, Defender for Endpoint, and Cortex XSOAR).

• Strong background in detection rule development, security investigations, and threat hunting across multiple telemetry sources.

• Experience with scripting, automation, APIs, and tools such as Python, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices.

• Knowledge of security query languages and frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK.

• Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Datenanalyst

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 8128

Als Data Analyst spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit, Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Datenprozesse. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der gerne mit komplexen Datensätzen arbeitet, mit Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet und technische Herausforderungen mit einer strukturierten, analytischen Denkweise löst. Wenn Sie motiviert, neugierig und eifrig sind, zu qualitativ hochwertigen Datenoperationen beizutragen, bietet diese Rolle eine großartige Gelegenheit, zu wachsen und etwas zu bewirken.

Was Sie tun werden

• Führen Sie das technische Onboarding von Fondsdatenanbietern durch, einschließlich Dateianalyse, Zuordnungskonfiguration, Tests und Bereitstellung der Produktion

• Überwachung und Verwaltung der Datenlieferungen, Gewährleistung einer erfolgreichen Verarbeitung und Aufrechterhaltung der Regeln für die Postfachweiterleitung

• Koordination mit Stakeholdern zur Klärung von Anforderungen und Unterstützung von Onboarding und operativen Aktivitäten

• Untersuchung und Lösung von Daten, Mapping und technischen Problemen, bei Bedarf Eskalation komplexer Fälle

• Überwachung der täglichen Verarbeitung und Ausnahmen in DataHub, Xceptor und verwandten Systemen zur Gewährleistung der Betriebsstabilität

• Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und Referenzdaten, einschließlich Share-Class-Mappings, Asset-Klassifizierungen und Coverage-Analysen

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder Informatik und mindestens 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen

• gute Kenntnisse der Finanzmärkte und Wertpapierinstrumente

• analytische, methodische, technische, problemlösende Fähigkeiten sind eine Schlüsselstärke

• motivierter, neugieriger und organisierter Teamplayer mit einem "Can Do" -Geist

• ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Fähigkeiten in Englisch

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter +48 538 562 645 an

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste des données

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

En tant qu'analyste de données, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la précision, la stabilité et la fiabilité de nos processus de données. Cette position est idéale pour quelqu'un qui aime travailler avec des ensembles de données complexes, collaborer avec les intervenants et résoudre les défis techniques avec un état d'esprit structuré et analytique. Si vous êtes motivé, curieux et désireux de contribuer à des opérations de données de haute qualité, ce rôle offre une excellente occasion de grandir et d'avoir un impact.

Ce que vous ferez

• effectuer l'embarquement technique des fournisseurs de données du fonds, y compris l'analyse des fichiers, la configuration des cartes, les essais et le déploiement de la production

• surveiller et gérer les livraisons de données, assurer le traitement efficace et maintenir les règles de transmission des boîtes aux lettres

• coordonner avec les parties prenantes pour clarifier les exigences et l'appui aux activités de bord et opérationnelles

• enquêter sur les données, la cartographie et les problèmes techniques et les résoudre, en augmentant les cas complexes au besoin

• surveiller le traitement quotidien et les exceptions dans DataHub, Xceptor et les systèmes connexes pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle

• maintenir la qualité des données et les données de référence, y compris la cartographie des classes de parts, la classification des actifs et l'analyse de la couverture;

Ce que vous apportez

• Licence ou diplôme d'études supérieures en finance, économie ou informatique et au moins 1 an d'expérience dans les services financiers

• bonne connaissance des marchés financiers et des instruments de valeurs mobilières

• Les compétences analytiques, méthodologiques, techniques et en résolution de problèmes constituent une force clé

• motivé, curieux et organisé joueur d'équipe avec un "peut faire" esprit

• excellentes compétences verbales et écrites en anglais

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks) Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7582 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as the Lead Data Platform Engineer of our Data Platform & Analytics squad. You will own the roadmap and evolution of our Data Science Platform on Azure and Databricks the self-service foundation that data scientists, analysts, business analysts, and AI engineers across the organization rely on to turn complex financial data into production-ready insights. This is a player-coach leadership role with direct line management responsibility for a small squad. You will remain close to the code, set technical direction for the platform, partner closely with the rest of the team to productionize what we build while partnering with other technical and business stakeholders. What You Will Do
• Own the Data Science Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the technical strategy for the DSP on Azure Databricks, balancing platform stability, self-service capabilities, and the evolving needs of data scientists and AI engineers.
• Productize Analytics Solutions: Lead the productization of the advanced dashboarding and analytics data products, turning prototypes into reliable, well-governed, scalable data products that can be reliably consumed by end users.
• Build Self-Service Foundations: Design and operate the lakehouse architecture, data pipelines and curated models, and governance patterns (Unity Catalog, dbt, access controls) that enable analysts and scientists to work autonomously on financial data.
• Lead and Grow the Squad: Line manage and and mentor a small team of data platform engineers, set engineering standards, review design and code, and coordinate with rotating contributors to deliver against the roadmap.
• Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with the MLOps / Platform Engineering team on CI/CD and observability, with the AI Solutions and Productization squads on data needs, and with business stakeholders to align the platform with real analytics and self-service use cases. What You Bring
• Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, SQL, and Python. Solid command of lakehouse architectures, data modeling, analytics engineering practices and production-grade data pipelines.
• Platform Mindset: Proven experience designing and operating data platforms in enterprise or regulated environments, including Unity Catalog governance and cost/performance optimization.
• Player-coach Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team while staying hands-on in architecture, implementation, code reviews, and production delivery.
• Productization & Self-Service: Experience taking analytics or data products from prototype to production and enabling self-service consumption by non-platform teams (data scientists, analysts, business users).
• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with financial data structures and the demands of data-driven systems in complex, regulated organizations is highly desirable.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles. Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Azure or Databricks certifications are a strong plus. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. Head Clearing Product & Business Development Madrid, London, Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7862 SIX Securities Services operates the processes downstream of securities trading including clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance and trade reporting. As part of SIX Securities Services, SIX Clearing plays a key role in the European post-trade value chain, offering highly diversified CCP clearing across several asset classes and services with access to multiple trading platforms across Europe. Operating out of Madrid, Zurich and Oslo, SIX Clearing has a truly pan-European footprint. As Head of Product & Business Development – Clearing you will be responsible for the end-to-end product and growth agenda of SIX’s clearing services across multiple asset classes. You will lead two specialised teams—Product Management and Business Development—each headed by an experienced team lead. In this senior role, you shape clearing strategy, drive growth initiatives, ensure product competitiveness, and act as a key interface to clients, trading venues, regulators, and internal stakeholders. You are a member of the Clearing Management Committee and contribute directly to the strategic direction of the clearing business. What You Will Do
• Lead Product Management and Business Development for all clearing products across five asset classes, managing two team leaders and overall team performance.
• Define and execute the clearing product strategy and roadmap, ensuring competitiveness in terms of coverage, connectivity, pricing, and service levels. Identify and drive growth opportunities, including new market segments, trading venue connections, partnerships, and interoperability initiatives, with ownership of business cases and regulatory processes.
• Act as senior business interface and escalation point for strategic clearing members, trading venues, and key partners, closely aligned with the Executive Team and Sales.
• Represent Clearing at senior internal and external forums, including the Clearing Management Committee, regulatory and industry working groups, and selected client events. What You Bring
• University degree in economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
• Extensive experience in post-trade financial market infrastructure, clearing, exchanges, or related financial services. As a clearing expert you fundamentally understand the industry and product mechanisms of Liquidity, Collateral, Balance Sheet Optimisation and Margin across different asset classes.
• You naturally build senior strategic relationships both internally and externally, translating ideas into roadmaps and operational execution. Track record of fostering strong commercial relationships with customers, partners and suppliers.
• Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial mindset, with experience owning product strategies, business cases, and growth initiatives.
• An entrepreneurial nature with an intuitive understanding of how to create value in a highly competitive business. A thought leader with a strong affinity for continuous innovation and an ability to synthesise customer sentiment, competitor initiatives and trends in both direct and adjacent markets, in order to stay ahead of - and ideally, harness - industry disruption
• Proven people-leadership skills, including managing senior professionals and team leads in a complex, cross-functional, international environment and excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills at senior management, client, and regulatory level.
• Excellent oral and written English skills; German and/or Spanish is an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

You are a member of the Clearing Management Committee and contribute directly to the strategic direction of the clearing business.

What You Will Do

• Define and execute the clearing product strategy and roadmap, ensuring competitiveness in terms of coverage, connectivity, pricing, and service levels.
Identify and drive growth opportunities, including new market segments, trading venue connections, partnerships, and interoperability initiatives, with ownership of business cases and regulatory processes.

• Represent Clearing at senior internal and external forums, including the Clearing Management Committee, regulatory and industry working groups, and selected client events.

What You Bring

• University degree in economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

• Extensive experience in post-trade financial market infrastructure, clearing, exchanges, or related financial services. As a clearing expert you fundamentally understand the industry and product mechanisms of Liquidity, Collateral, Balance Sheet Optimisation and Margin across different asset classes.

• You naturally build senior strategic relationships both internally and externally, translating ideas into roadmaps and operational execution. Track record of fostering strong commercial relationships with customers, partners and suppliers.

• Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial mindset, with experience owning product strategies, business cases, and growth initiatives.

• An entrepreneurial nature with an intuitive understanding of how to create value in a highly competitive business. A thought leader with a strong affinity for continuous innovation and an ability to synthesise customer sentiment, competitor initiatives and trends in both direct and adjacent markets, in order to stay ahead of - and ideally, harness - industry disruption

• Proven people-leadership skills, including managing senior professionals and team leads in a complex, cross-functional, international environment and excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills at senior management, client, and regulatory level.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7940

If you have strong experience in QA and Test Management, combined with a structured mindset and the ability to align diverse teams around common standards, we would welcome you to join us as QA & Testing Governance Lead within Securities Services IT at SIX.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of hands‑on experience in QA, Test Management or Quality Governance in complex IT environments (regulated or mission‑critical contexts are a strong advantage).

• Proven experience defining and rolling out standards, governance models, processes and metrics across multiple teams or units.

• Strong understanding of test phases, testing strategies, entry/exit criteria, defect management and production readiness.

• Solid knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools and evidence‑based quality reporting, including metrics that help connect quality outcomes with delivery performance.

• Location in Spain, with willingness to travel occasionally to Switzerland.

• Fluent English (mandatory); Spanish highly valued; German a plus.

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Senior Data Architect Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637 The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function. We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced. This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents. What You Will Do
• Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
• Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
• Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
• Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
• Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement. What You Bring
• Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
• 5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
• Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
• Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential. Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Trade Surveillance Analyst (80-100%)

Zurich, up to 40% HomeOffice possible, Reference 8011

Are you interested in the financial markets? This position offers you the chance to experience the stock exchange business at close range and in a unique working environment.

To strengthen our market supervision & Berlin team in Zurich, we are looking for a dedicated person as Trade Surveillance Analyst. In this role, we focus on monitoring, identifying and investigating potential market abuses of trading activities and possible regulatory abuses of market participants. In addition, you actively participate in the further development and optimization of the monitoring systems.

Tasks

- Monitoring of the trading venue in relation to abnormalities (market manipulation, intra-Community transactions, rule infringements, etc.) accompanied by the conduct of data analyses and the drafting of preliminary clarification and investigation reports on the hands of the supervisory and law enforcement authorities - Contact person for dealers and participants in regulatory issues - Further development or.

Support for monitoring tools and scenarios by identifying trends and patterns - contribution and support of reporting obligations (monthly reports, quarterly reports, etc.) - participation and support of projects in the department

Requirements

- Higher degree (university or university) in economics, finance, etc. or equivalent banking training or several years of compliance experience in the field of trade and investment banking - Ideally, expertise and experience in the trading of various asset classes (shares, bonds, warrants) - Ability to capture complex relationships and to present them to the addressee - A strong analytical thinking ability - Excellent language skills (negotiable in German and English, French desirable)

We offer

- A dynamic and innovative working environment - The possibility of shaping the future of financial markets - Flexible working conditions (up to 40% HomeOffice possible)

Interessierst du dich für die Finanzmärkte? Diese Position bietet dir die Chance, den Börsenbetrieb aus nächster Nähe und in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld zu erleben.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Markets Supervision & Investigation-Teams in Zürich suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Trade Surveillance Analyst. In dieser Rolle liegt der Fokus auf der Überwachung, Erkennung und Untersuchung potenziell marktmissbräuchlicher Handelsaktivitäten sowie möglicher Regelverstösse von Marktteilnehmenden. Zudem wirkst du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung der Überwachungssysteme mit.

Aufgaben

- Überwachung des Handelsplatzes in Bezug auf Auffälligkeiten (Marktmanipulation, Insidergeschäfte, Regelverstösse etc.) einhergehend mit der Durchführung von Datenanalysen und Verfassen von Vorabklärungs- und Untersuchungsberichten zu Händen der Aufsichts- und Strafverfolgungsbehörden
- Ansprechperson für Händler und Teilnehmer bei regulatorischen Fragen
- Weiterentwicklung bzw. Unterstützung der Überwachungstools und Szenarien durch Erkennen von Trends und Patterns
- Beitrag und Unterstützung der Reportingverpflichtungen (Monatsberichte, Quartalsberichte etc.)
- Teilnahme und Unterstützung von Projekten im Fachbereich

Anforderungen

- Höherer Abschluss (Fachhochschule oder Universität) im Bereich Wirtschaft, Finanzen u. a. oder gleichwertige Bankfachausbildung bzw. mehrjährige Compliance-Erfahrung im Bereich Handel und Investmentbanking
- Idealerweise Expertise und mehrjährige Erfahrung im Handel von verschiedenen Assetklassen (Aktien, Bonds, Warrants)
- Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu erfassen und adressatengerecht darzustellen
- Ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen
- Exzellente Sprachkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch, Französisch wünschenswert)

Wir bieten

- Ein dynamisches und innovatives Arbeitsumfeld
- Die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte zu gestalten
- Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen (bis zu 40% Homeoffice möglich)

Kontakt

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Maria Teresa Buchanan unter der Nummer +41 58 399 8083.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX est le moteur de la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue est ce qui nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

Analyste de la surveillance commerciale (80-100%)

Zurich | Jusqu'à 40 % de bureau à domicile possible | Référence 8011

Les marchés financiers vous intéressent ? Ce poste vous offre la possibilité de vivre de près les opérations boursières et dans un environnement de travail unique.

Pour renforcer notre équipe de surveillance et d'enquête des marchés à Zurich, nous recherchons une personne engagée en tant qu'analyste de surveillance commerciale. Dans ce rôle, l'accent est mis sur la surveillance, l'identification et l'enquête sur les activités de négociation potentiellement abusives sur le marché ainsi que sur les éventuelles violations des règles par les acteurs du marché. Vous participerez également activement au développement et à l’optimisation des systèmes de surveillance.

Tâches

- Surveillance de la plate-forme de négociation au regard des anomalies (manipulations de marché, délits d'initiés, violations des règles, etc.) ainsi que réalisation d'analyses de données et rédaction de rapports d'enquête préliminaire et d'enquête à l'attention des autorités de contrôle et des forces de l'ordre.
- Interlocuteur des traders et participants pour les questions réglementaires
- Développement et support d'outils et de scénarios de surveillance en identifiant les tendances et les modèles
- Contribution et support aux obligations de reporting (rapports mensuels, rapports trimestriels, etc.)
- Participation et accompagnement des projets du département

Exigences

- Diplôme supérieur (école technique ou université) dans le domaine de l'économie, de la finance, etc. ou formation bancaire équivalente ou plusieurs années d'expérience en conformité dans le domaine de la banque de trading et d'investissement
- Idéalement expertise et plusieurs années d'expérience dans le trading de diverses classes d'actifs (actions, obligations, warrants)
- Capacité à appréhender des relations complexes et à les présenter de manière appropriée
- Solides capacités de réflexion analytique
- Excellentes compétences linguistiques (parle couramment l'allemand et l'anglais, français souhaitable)

Nous offrons

- Un environnement de travail dynamique et innovant
- L'opportunité de façonner l'avenir des marchés financiers
- Conditions de travail flexibles (jusqu'à 40% de télétravail possible)

Contacter

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Maria Teresa Buchanan au +41 58 399 8083.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, c'est pourquoi nous acceptons les candidatures indépendamment de vos antécédents personnels.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Governance Officer

Warsaw | working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7983

Do you want to play a key role in shaping technology governance to enable business objectives in a complex and regulated environment? Are you motivated by improving decision making, transparency, and accountability across IT?

If so, our Information Technology team would like to hear from you.

As an IT Governance Officer, you will play a central role in defining and embedding IT governance practices that align technology investments with business strategy. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long term scalability and resilience.

What You Will Do

• lead the definition and maintenance of policies and frameworks for enterprise-wide IT Governance.

• support the CIO organization in steering governance, ensuring alignment with IT Governance principles, standards, and long-term scalability objectives.

• facilitate IT steering committees and governance boards, preparing decision making artefacts, documenting outcomes, and promoting accountability.

• provide expert input to senior risk and compliance committees on technology governance, operational resilience, outsourcing, and third-party risk.

• drive awareness and change initiatives to embed a strong governance culture across IT and business departments.

• promote continuous improvement within IT by encouraging standardization, documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams.

• Take a more active role in shaping governance frameworks, facilitating governance boards and steering committees, and providing expert input to senior risk, compliance, and decision‑making forums.

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• relevant professional experience in IT governance, enterprise architecture, or a related discipline, ideally in a financial services or regulated environment. (The scope of responsibilities and level of autonomy will be adapted based on experience.)

• understanding of IT governance and service management frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, and ISO 38500.

• proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and facilitate effective decision making at senior management level.

• strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.

• fluency in English; German or Spanish is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Accounting Internship

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8093

Would you like to grow in a dynamic environment and learn how an accounting department operates? Then our team wants to hear from you!
We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for the statutory and regulatory reporting of the BME Group and its subsidiaries. Our goal is to optimize financial resources and ensure efficient reporting and accuracy of financial data. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the General Ledger and Reporting area of the finance department, participating in the different tasks from daily bookings to consolidation.

What You Will Do

• Assist in the preparation and issuance of financial reports and data analysis

• Support the implementation of financial processes and controls

• Assist in performing accounting entries

• Help with reporting to the regulator

What You Bring

• Final-year student in Business, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

• Interest in learning and developing in the financial sector

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Good communication and teamwork skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and similar tools

• Fluent English (both verbal and written); other languages are a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Responsabile Marketing Sociale Zurigo, Madrid, Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 8062 Sei appassionato di modellare il social marketing strategico su scala e leader team attraverso la trasformazione? Si prospera in un ambiente internazionale, globale e godere di collaborare strettamente con l'azienda per creare un impatto misurabile? Poi unisciti al nostro team internazionale di comunicazioni digitali come responsabile del marketing sociale. Il ruolo può essere basato a Varsavia (Polonia), Madrid (Spagna), o Zurigo (Svizzera). In questo ruolo, guiderai il nostro team di social media e possiederai la direzione strategica del marketing sociale pagato e organico attraverso i nostri canali. Con la vostra esperienza di leadership, mentalità strategica, e guidare per l'eccellenza, vi aiuterà a rafforzare i nostri marchi SIX e BME, elevare la nostra maturità di marketing sociale, e consentire al vostro team di agire come consulenti affidabili per il business. Investiamo nello sviluppo dei nostri leader e ti sosteniamo in continua espansione delle tue capacità e capacità. Come azienda moderna e innovativa all'incrocio tra tecnologia e finanza, SIX offre una vasta gamma di opportunità per ottenere un impatto significativo e sfruttare appieno il potenziale. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura in inglese. Cosa farai
• Guidare e allenare un team distribuito da remoto di tre specialisti dei social media, promuovendo un approccio strategico al social marketing, una mentalità di consulenza, responsabilità e una delegazione efficace.
• Proprio la strategia di marketing sociale end-to-end attraverso attività pagate e organiche, allineati con obiettivi di business e marketing.
• Stabilire e migliorare continuamente flussi di lavoro e modelli per garantire scalabilità, qualità ed efficienza attraverso la collaborazione remota.
• Agire come proprietario responsabile per i risultati del marketing sociale, traducendo gli obiettivi in KPI e prestazioni misurabili; include la gestione della crisi leader nei canali sociali quando applicabile.
• Agire come partner strategico proattivo per gli stakeholder interni e proporre soluzioni in ambienti contrattati dalle risorse. Che cosa porta
• Laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business, Digital Media o un campo correlato, con almeno 6 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nel marketing dei social media.
• Provata esperienza leader di team di social media remoti o virtuali, con forti capacità di leadership online, coaching e sviluppo delle persone.
• Profonda competenza nel marketing sociale strategico, comprese le campagne a pagamento, la misurazione delle prestazioni e l'ottimizzazione.
• Dimostrata capacità di allenare le squadre verso un modo consultivo di lavorare, andando oltre consegna puramente esecutiva.
• Forte mentalità di processo e di trasformazione, con esperienza di costruire modi scalabili di lavorare in organizzazioni complesse; è richiesto l'inglese fluente, le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono molto preferite ma non obbligatorie. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645 Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Social Marketing

Zurich, Madrid, Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8062

Are you passionate about shaping strategic social marketing at scale and leading teams through transformation? Do you thrive in an international, global environment and enjoy partnering closely with the business to create measurable impact? Then join our international Digital Communications team as Head of Social Marketing. The role can be based in Warsaw (Poland), Madrid (Spain), or Zurich (Switzerland).

In this role, you will lead our social media team and own the strategic direction of paid and organic social marketing across our channels. With your leadership experience, strategic mindset, and drive for excellence, you will help strengthen our brands SIX and BME, elevate our social marketing maturity, and enable your team to act as trusted advisors to the business.

We invest in the development of our leaders and support you in continuously expanding your skills and capabilities.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential. We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Lead and coach a remotely distributed team of three social media specialists, fostering a strategic approach to social marketing, a consultancy mindset, accountability, and effective delegation.

Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Responsable du marketing social Zurich, Madrid, Varsovie Êtes-vous passionné de façonner le marketing social stratégique à l'échelle et de diriger des équipes par la transformation? prospèrez-vous dans un environnement international et mondial et aimez-vous vous associer étroitement à l'entreprise pour créer un impact mesurable? Ensuite, rejoignez notre équipe internationale de communications numériques en tant que responsable du marketing social. Le rôle peut être basé à Varsovie (Pologne), Madrid (Espagne) ou Zurich (Suisse). Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez notre équipe de médias sociaux et posséderez la direction stratégique du marketing social payé et biologique sur nos canaux. Grâce à votre expérience de leadership, votre esprit d'entreprise stratégique et votre volonté d'excellence, vous aiderez à renforcer nos marques SIX et BME, à élever notre maturité en marketing social et à permettre à votre équipe d'agir en tant que conseillers de confiance pour l'entreprise. Nous investissons dans le développement de nos leaders et vous accompagnons dans le développement continu de vos compétences et de vos capacités. En tant qu'entreprise moderne et innovante à la croisée de la technologie et de la finance, SIX offre un large éventail d'opportunités pour faire un impact significatif et exploiter pleinement votre potentiel. • Dirigez et entraînez une équipe à distance de trois spécialistes des médias sociaux, favorisant une approche stratégique du marketing social, une mentalité de conseil, la responsabilité et une délégation efficace.
• Posséder la stratégie de marketing social de bout en bout pour les activités rémunérées et biologiques, en harmonie avec les objectifs commerciaux et marketing.
• Établir et améliorer continuellement les flux de travail et les modèles pour assurer l'évolutivité, la qualité et l'efficacité de la collaboration à distance.
• Agir en tant que propriétaire responsable des résultats du marketing social, en traduisant les objectifs en ICR et en mesurant la performance; inclure la gestion des crises par les voies sociales, le cas échéant.
• Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique proactif pour les intervenants internes et proposer des solutions dans des environnements où les ressources sont limitées. Ce que vous apportez
• Baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires, médias numériques, ou un domaine connexe, avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en marketing de médias sociaux.
• Expérience éprouvée dirigeant des équipes de médias sociaux à distance ou virtuels, avec un leadership en ligne solide, un coaching et des compétences de développement des personnes.
• Expertise approfondie en marketing social stratégique, y compris les campagnes rémunérées, la mesure du rendement et l'optimisation.
• Capacité démontrée d'entraîner les équipes vers un mode de travail consultatif, allant au-delà de l'exécution pure.
• Un processus solide et l'esprit de transformation, avec l'expérience de construire des façons évolutives de travailler dans des organisations complexes; l'anglais couramment est nécessaire, les compétences en langue allemande sont hautement préférées mais pas obligatoire. Are you motivated by improving decision making, transparency, and accountability across IT? If so, our Information Technology team would like to hear from you. As an IT Governance Officer, you will play a central role in defining and embedding IT governance practices that align technology investments with business strategy. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long term scalability and resilience. What You Will Do
• lead the definition and maintenance of policies and frameworks for enterprise-wide IT Governance.
• support the CIO organization in steering governance, ensuring alignment with IT Governance principles, standards, and long-term scalability objectives.
• facilitate IT steering committees and governance boards, preparing decision making artefacts, documenting outcomes, and promoting accountability.
• provide expert input to senior risk and compliance committees on technology governance, operational resilience, outsourcing, and third-party risk.
• drive awareness and change initiatives to embed a strong governance culture across IT and business departments.
• promote continuous improvement within IT by encouraging standardization, documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams. What You Bring
• master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
• relevant professional experience in IT governance, enterprise architecture, or a related discipline, ideally in a financial services or regulated environment. (The scope of responsibilities and level of autonomy will be adapted based on experience.)
• understanding of IT governance and service management frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, and ISO 38500.
• proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and facilitate effective decision making at senior management level.
• strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
• fluency in English; German or Spanish is an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7982

Do you want to play a key role in shaping technology governance to enable business objectives in a complex and regulated environment? Are you motivated by improving decision making, transparency, and accountability across IT?

If so, our Information Technology team would like to hear from you.

As an IT Governance Officer, you will play a central role in defining and embedding IT governance practices that align technology investments with business strategy. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long term scalability and resilience.

What You Will Do

• lead the definition and maintenance of policies and frameworks for enterprise-wide IT Governance.

• support the CIO organization in steering governance, ensuring alignment with IT Governance principles, standards, and long-term scalability objectives.

• facilitate IT steering committees and governance boards, preparing decision making artefacts, documenting outcomes, and promoting accountability.

• provide expert input to senior risk and compliance committees on technology governance, operational resilience, outsourcing, and third-party risk.

• drive awareness and change initiatives to embed a strong governance culture across IT and business departments.

• promote continuous improvement within IT by encouraging standardization, documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams.

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• relevant professional experience in IT governance, enterprise architecture, or a related discipline, ideally in a financial services or regulated environment. (The scope of responsibilities and level of autonomy will be adapted based on experience.)

• understanding of IT governance and service management frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, and ISO 38500.

• proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and facilitate effective decision making at senior management level.

• strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.

• fluency in English; German or Spanish is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

IT DevOps Engineer

Madrid, Barcelona | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7856

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational robustness are key principles?
Are you motivated to learn, grow your technical skills, and contribute to modern DevOps practices while working alongside experienced engineers?
If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
We are looking for an Application Ops Engineer to join our Operations Team and support application development teams through automation, standardized CI/CD pipelines, and the configuration of shared operational platforms.
In this role, you will contribute to building and operating scalable deployment and automation solutions, while gaining hands-on experience with tools such as GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow, and Python, and collaborating closely with developers and platform teams to ensure operational quality and Operations best practices across the application lifecycle.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and ArgoCD

• Develop, adapt, and maintain reusable automation templates using Ansible

• Support development teams in integrating deployment pipelines, workflows, and observability configurations

• Assist in the operation and improvement of scheduling and workflow automation platforms such as Airflow

• Write and maintain Python scripts to support automation, integrations, and operational tasks

• Help drive standardization, security, and scalability in build and deployment workflows

• Collaborate with central infrastructure teams on provisioning, upgrades, and shared platform services (e.g. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Document processes, configurations, and best practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Learn and apply modern DevOps tooling and practices, sharing knowledge within the team

What You Bring

• A strong interest in DevOps and automation across the software delivery lifecycle

• Hands-on experience or practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD, or similar tools

• Basic experience with Python for scripting or automation purposes

• Familiarity with Linux environments and application deployments

• Exposure to observability or monitoring tools such as Grafana, ELK, Prometheus is a plus

• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and collaborate in a cross-functional environment

• Proactive mindset, good communication skills, and a team-oriented attitude

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Guided Tours & BME Events Internship (Morning Schedule)

Madrid | Flexible Working Model | Reference 8004

Are you studying and do you have skills in the field of events management, communication and public relations? Are you interested in the Communication and Marketing sector and looking for an interesting internship to learn more about financial sector?
If your answer is yes, our Events and Conferences team, responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you.

We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do a morning internship at BME, here you will provide hands-on assistance in the Events and Conferences area. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1).

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• carry out the guided tours, oversee mailbox and answer inquiries for guided tours, administrating and managing all incoming requests (mail/telephone)

• collaboration in the development of the materials and speeches for the guided tours, acquiring knowledge and history related to the stock market and its surroundings (Stock Exchange Palace)

• support the event managers in all aspects of event management (planning, preparing, execution, event material, invitation and registration management, etc.)

• provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work

• on-Site support at events

What You Bring

• studies in Marketing, Communication, Tourism, Bussines Administration or Event Organization

• ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills

• strong organizational skills and personal flexibility

• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills

• very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)

• experience in hosting virtual events is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge a fare il passo: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT Olten | 100% | Reference 7804 Sei appassionato di lavorare nell'IT nel settore finanziario e ti piace collaborare strettamente con sia le aziende che gli stakeholder IT? In questo ruolo, progetta e modella soluzioni in stretta collaborazione con i team aziendali e tecnologici, utilizzando le tue forti competenze comunicative e organizzative. Unisciti al nostro team di servizi informatici Asset e aiuta a fornire soluzioni di impatto all'interno del dominio Corporate Actions. Cosa farete
• Incollaggi proattivi con i team di business e product management per individuare miglioramenti e opportunità
• Per nuovi progetti e cambiamenti preparare soluzioni scalabili, sicure, economicamente efficaci in base alle esigenze aziendali
• Gestione delle parti interessate e comunicare le tappe principali agli stakeholder
• Preparare documenti di soluzione per l'IT per avviare lo sviluppo, guidare lo sviluppo IT
• Preparare caso di prova che il team di sviluppo può utilizzare per testare il nuovo sviluppo
• Testare e analizzare il codice sviluppato per garantire che soddisfi i requisiti aziendali e segue tutte le linee guida di sviluppo e standards What You Bring
• Esperienza professionale rilevante (10+ anni) nello sviluppo IT insieme alla progettazione di soluzioni.
• Conoscenze di lavoro in COBOL e Java (Spring Boot Framework) & Assistenza ai beni/Azioni aziendali è richiesta conoscenza/esperienza aziendale
• Comprensione dello standard SWIFT di messaggistica MT/MX
• Dovrebbe avere la capacità di imparare nuovi strumenti e concetto IT, così come priorità fissate, buone capacità di tiro difficoltà e alta motivazione
• Ottime conoscenze in Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point ecc. Dovrebbe essere anche comodo con Jira
• Ottime abilità di comunicazione in inglese, tedesco sarebbe un plus Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Maria Teresa Buchanan al +41 58 399 8083. Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi sfondo personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT

Olten | 100% | Reference 7804

Are you passionate about working in IT within the financial industry and enjoy collaborating closely with both business and IT stakeholders? In this role, you will design and shape solutions in close partnership with the business and technology teams, using your strong communication and organizational skills. Join our Asset Services IT team and help deliver impactful solutions within the Corporate Actions domain.

What You Will Do

• Proactively liaise with business and product management teams to identify improvements and opportunities

• For new projects and changes prepare scalable, secure, cost-effective solutions based on the business requirements

• Stakeholder management and communicate milestones to the stakeholders

• Prepare solution documents for IT to start development, guide the IT development

• Prepare test case that development team can use to test the new development

• Testing and analyzing the developed code to ensure it meets business requirements and follows all development guidelines and standards

What You Bring

• Relevant professional experience (10+ years) in IT Development along with Solution design.

• Working knowledge in COBOL and Java (Spring Boot framework) & Asset servicing/Corporate Actions business knowledge/experience is required

• Understanding of SWIFT Messaging MT/MX Standard

• Should have the capability to learn new tools and IT concept, as well as set priorities, good trouble shooting skills and high motivation

• Very good knowledge in Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point etc. Should be also comfortable with Jira

• Very good communication skills in English, German would be a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Finanzwirtschaft mit uns. Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT Olten, 100%, Reference 7804 Sie sind leidenschaftlich in der IT-Branche zu arbeiten und genießen die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmen und IT-Stakeholdern? In dieser Funktion entwerfen und gestalten Sie Lösungen in enger Partnerschaft mit den Geschäfts- und Technologieteams mit Ihren starken Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten. Begleiten Sie unser IT-Team Asset Services und helfen Sie dabei, im Bereich Corporate Actions wirkungsvolle Lösungen zu liefern. Was Sie tun werden
• Proaktive Verbindung mit den Unternehmens- und Produktmanagementteams, um Verbesserungen und Chancen zu identifizieren
• Für neue Projekte und Änderungen bereiten skalierbare, sichere und kostengünstige Lösungen vor, die auf den Geschäftsanforderungen basieren
• Stakeholdermanagement und Meilensteine an die Stakeholder weitergeben
• Vorbereitung von Lösungsdokumenten für IT zum Start der Entwicklung, Anleitung für die IT-Entwicklung
• Vorbereitung von Testfällen, mit denen das Entwicklungsteam die neue Entwicklung testen kann
• Prüfung und Analyse des entwickelten Codes, um sicherzustellen, dass er den Geschäftsanforderungen entspricht und allen Entwicklungsrichtlinien und Standards Was Sie mitbringen
• Relevante Berufserfahrung (10+ Jahre) in der IT-Entwicklung zusammen mit Lösungsdesign.
• Arbeitswissen in COBOL und Java (Spring Boot Framework) & Asset Service/Corporate Actions Business Knowledge/Experience ist erforderlich
• Verständnis von SWIFT Messaging MT/MX Standard
• Sollte die Fähigkeit haben, neue Tools und IT-Konzepte zu lernen, sowie Prioritäten, gute Probleme schießen Fähigkeiten und hohe Motivation
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point etc. Sollte auch mit Jira bequem sein
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, Deutsch wäre ein Plus Bei Fragen, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Maria Teresa Buchanan unter +41 58 399 8083. Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur direkte Bewerbungen. Diversität ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von jedem persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce qui nous distingue nous conduit à l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Analyste de solutions - Service d'actifs IT Olten, 100%, Référence 7804 Vous êtes passionné par le travail dans l'informatique au sein du secteur financier et aimez collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires commerciaux et informatiques? Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez et façonnerez des solutions en partenariat étroit avec les équipes commerciales et technologiques, en utilisant vos compétences en communication et en organisation. Rejoignez notre équipe IT Asset Services et aidez à fournir des solutions impactées dans le domaine des Actions Corporate.
• Établir des liens avec les équipes de gestion des affaires et des produits pour identifier les améliorations et les possibilités
• Pour de nouveaux projets et changements, préparer des solutions évolutives, sûres et rentables en fonction des besoins opérationnels
• Gestion des parties prenantes et communiquer les étapes importantes aux parties prenantes
• Préparer des documents de solution pour les TI pour commencer le développement, guider le développement informatique
• Préparer un cas d'essai que l'équipe de développement peut utiliser pour tester le nouveau développement
• Tester et analyser le code développé pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux besoins opérationnels et suit toutes les lignes directrices de développement et standards Ce que vous apportez
• Expérience professionnelle pertinente (10+ ans) en développement informatique avec la conception de la solution.
• Connaissances de travail en COBOL et Java (cadre de démarrage) & Service d'actifs/Actions d'entreprise est nécessaire
• Connaissances/expérience d'entreprise
• Comprendre la messagerie SWIFT MT/MX Standard
• Doit avoir la capacité d'apprendre de nouveaux outils et concept informatique, ainsi que de définir des priorités, de bonnes compétences de tir à la difficulté et une motivation élevée
• Très bonne connaissance dans Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point etc. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Maria Teresa Buchanan au +41 58 399 8083. Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons seulement les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir les candidatures indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Enterprise Architect Warsaw | 100% | Reference 8035 Do you want to shape enterprise-wide processes in a complex and regulated environment? Are you passionate about aligning business and IT through structured process management and architecture? Our Enterprise Architecture team defines and governs the architectural landscape across business and IT domains, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives, business processes, and IT capabilities. In this role, you will contribute to the design and evolution of enterprise-wide processes and collaborate closely with domain architects, product teams, and business stakeholders. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long-term scalability and resilience. What You Will Do
• contribute to the design and evolution of enterprise architecture, with a strong focus on process management and process architecture
• support and drive process modelling initiatives using BPMN 2.0
• help ensure alignment between business processes, IT systems, and architectural standards
• collaborate with stakeholders across business and IT to define and improve end-to-end processes
• contribute to architecture governance and standards, supporting consistency and regulatory alignment
• take ownership of architectural domains, drive initiatives independently, and contribute to strategic decision-making and governance What You Bring
• experience in enterprise architecture, with increasing responsibility in process management and architecture
• solid understanding of process modelling, including exposure to BPMN 2.0
• broad interest or experience across business, application, data, and technology domains
• experience in the financial services industry or other regulated environments is a plus
• master’s degree in a scientific field; PhD is an advantage
• fluent in English (both verbal and written); German is a plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Office Assistant and Event Coordinator Warsaw | 100% office based position | Reference 8006 We are looking for an organized and proactive Office Assistant & Event Coordinator to support daily office operations in Warsaw while delivering high-quality internal and external events. This role combines administration, logistics, and communication to ensure a smooth and engaging workplace experience. What You Will Do
• manage day-to-day office administration, including supplies, equipment, and vendor coordination
• ensure a safe, clean, and well-functioning workspace while supporting reception and onboarding logistics
• plan and deliver internal events such as town halls, team activities, and engagement initiatives
• support external events, client visits, and leadership meetings, including logistics and vendor coordination
• drive clear office communication and maintain event calendars, budgets, and documentation What You Bring
• strong organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail
• service-oriented mindset with a proactive and reliable approach
• excellent communication skills in Polish and English
• ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders
• proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel) with solid coordination skills If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645 For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
